jobs.title: Operations & Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**HOLLYWOOD TOYS \& COSTUMES**

6600 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90028 \| Serving Hollywood since 1950

**OPERATIONS \& PROJECT COORDINATOR**

**Job type: Part\-time, approximately three days per week. On site. Ongoing position.**

**About the job**

Hollywood Toys \& Costumes is looking for an organized, dependable person to help keep our operations running and to support the person who runs the business day to day. You will keep track of what has been ordered and what has arrived, keep our task list current, keep files and records where people can find them, and help on the sales floor when we are busy.

We are a 75\-year\-old independent shop on the Hollywood Walk of Fame with a very large Halloween season. This is a hands\-on job in a small business. You will be at a desk part of the day and on the floor the rest of it. If you like knowing where everything stands and you do not let things slip, you will do well here.

**What you will do**

* Keep the task list current. Write down what was decided, who is doing it, and when it is due, then follow up on anything still open.
* Track vendor orders: keep the vendor list up to date, note what was ordered, check off what arrives, and follow up on anything late or missing.
* Check invoices against what was ordered and received, and flag anything that does not match before it is paid.
* Keep our spreadsheets current: order history, reorder lists, buy sheets, size breakdowns and inventory counts.
* Enter numbers accurately, sort and filter lists, and use basic formulas to keep the sheets working.
* Keep the manager calendar current, take notes in meetings and write up who agreed to do what, and sort assigned email into the right order.
* Keep digital and paper files organized so vendor records, invoices, contracts and business documents can be found quickly.
* Pull Instagram and TikTok numbers on a set schedule and enter them into the tracking sheet.
* Write down how recurring tasks get done, step by step, so the next person can follow it without asking.
* Help with daily store work: receiving deliveries, counting, tagging, restocking, seasonal floor sets, and helping customers when we are busy.

**What we are looking forRequired**

* Experience in a job where other people depended on you keeping track of details. Retail, office, warehouse, school or similar all count. We care more about how you work than where you worked.
* Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets: entering data accurately, sorting and filtering, and using basic formulas. You will be asked to show us. We will teach you the rest.
* You can keep several things going at once without dropping any of them, and you follow up without being reminded.
* You write clearly and briefly. Short and specific beats long and vague.
* Comfortable with physical work: receiving deliveries, moving and restocking product, and being on your feet when we are busy.
* Reliable in\-person attendance on every scheduled shift. This job cannot be done from home.
* Saturday availability. Saturday is our busiest day of the week.
* Availability for extended hours and weekend coverage between September 15 and November 1, our peak season.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Nice to have, not required**

* Retail, warehouse, receiving or inventory experience.
* You have worked with purchase orders, packing slips or invoices before.
* You have used a task or project tracking tool such as Basecamp, Asana, Trello or Monday. We will train you on ours.
* You have used AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, and you know to check what they give you against the actual document.
* You have written instructions or checklists for other people to follow.

**What makes someone successful here**

* You notice the thing nobody assigned you, and you write it down.
* You would rather ask than guess on anything involving money, a vendor order, or a signed document.
* You are comfortable in a small business where everyone does more than their title says.
* You keep track of a lot of moving parts without losing any of them.

**Schedule**

Part\-time, approximately three days per week, generally fewer than 30 hours. Days and hours vary with the needs of the business and are not guaranteed. Saturday availability is required. Extended hours and weekend coverage are required during our peak season, September 15 through November 1, and pre\-planned time off is not available during that window.

**How to apply**

Apply through this posting, or bring your resume in person to 6600 Hollywood Blvd. Please include short answers to these three questions. We read them, and applications without them are unlikely to move forward.

* Tell us about a time you were responsible for keeping track of a lot of details. What were you keeping track of, and how did you keep it straight?
* Tell us about something at a past job that was slow, messy or confusing. What did you do about it?
* How comfortable are you with Excel or Google Sheets? Give one specific example of something you have made or maintained.

Please also confirm your availability, including Saturdays and our September to November peak season.

**About Hollywood Toys \& Costumes**

For 75 years Hollywood Toys \& Costumes has served tourists, locals and the film industry from the Hollywood Walk of Fame. Consistently named the best costume shop in Los Angeles, we carry one of the widest selections anywhere of adult and children’s costumes, wigs, masks, jewelry, FX makeup, novelties and magic. If you are looking for it, we have probably got it.

**Job Summary**

The Operations Coordinator works closely with the Co\-Executive Directors to support the smooth and efficient day\-to\-day operations of Young \& Healthy. This role is integral to ensuring organizational effectiveness and includes a wide range of responsibilities across multiple functions. Key duties involve managing administrative processes, supporting human resources activities such as onboarding and maintaining personnel records, assisting with financial tasks including expense tracking and invoice processing, and overseeing general office services to ensure a well\-functioning work environment. Additionally, the Operations Coordinator is responsible for coordinating facilities management, including vendor relations, supplies procurement, and maintaining a safe and organized workspace. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of professionalism and discretion.

**I. Organizational Operations**

a. Supports the Co\-Executive Directors in ensuring smooth and efficient daily operations across the organization.

b. Contributes to the management and oversight of office operations, policy development, and implementation.

c. Oversee the maintenance of office space, equipment, technology, inventory, and supplies to ensure a functional and professional work environment.

d. Acts as the primary liaison with the IT consultant to maintain open communication, ensure system functionality, and resolve technical issues promptly.

e. Manages the organization’s master calendar, internal filing systems, and routine correspondence to support operational efficiency.

f. Maintains and monitors compliance with all required permits, licenses, state and federal nonprofit registrations, and organizational policies.

g. Oversee the organizational manual to ensure accounting and personnel policies and procedures are current and properly implemented.

a. Serve as the secondary liaison between Young \& Healthy and financial institutions, auditors, accountants, and vendors.

c. Manages routine financial operations such as weekly deposits, remote deposit capture, accounts payable support, and tracking the organization’s supply budget.

**III. Human Resources**

Coordinates the following human resource functions:

a. Supports the management and maintenance of the employee policies and procedures handbook.

b. Oversee employee recruitment and onboarding with Young \& Healthy staff as appropriate.

c. In collaboration with the Co\-Executive Directors, helps in the development and implementation of policies and procedures.

d. Assists in ensuring organizational practices follow California law

e. May assist in the offboarding process

f. May coordinate insurance benefits for new hires and expedite individual insurance policy changes requested by employees

**IV. Professional Development** 

Continuously maintain and update a knowledge base of relevant skills and best practices pertaining to the fiscal, human resources, and operations responsibilities of the position.

**Qualifications:** The qualifications described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made upon request to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

c. Strong written and oral communication skills

d. Ability to fluently read, write, and speak English and Spanish

a. Commitment to maintaining the highest ethical standards

b. Strategic thinking and visioning

c. Leadership and team management

d. Relationship builder

f. Problem\-solving and decision\-making

* Enter information into sample portal.
* Order blanks.
* Submit pad print request and approve details of pad prints.
* Organize and maintain sample racks for internal reference.
* Prepare and send approval items to the customers (i.e. lab dips, fit samples, pp samples, bulk fabric, TOP’s, etc.).

jobs.description:
**Overview**

At Fabritec, we specialize in bespoke window treatment that elevate interior spaces with elegance and sophistication. Our clientele expects nothing but the finest materials, impeccable craftmanship, and tailored design solutions. We take pride in sourcing the world's most exquisite fabrics to create one\-of\-a\-kind pieces.

As an Account Manager in the Sales Department, you will be responsible for managing and nurturing relationships with key clients, ensuring the highest level of customer satisfaction, and driving sales growth. You will be a key player in maintaining our reputation for exceptional service, meeting company sales targets, and creating custom design solutions to successfully manage client needs and expectations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Client Relationship Management: Build, develop, and maintain strong, long\-lasting relationships with high\-net\-worth clients in the luxury window treatment sector.

. Sales and Account Growth: Drive sales through proactive account management, uncovering new opportunities for existing clients, and managing a portfolio of key accounts.

· Customer Support: Provide tailored support to clients, addressing inquires, handling issues, and delivering exceptional post sale care.

· Problem Solving: Work with clients to identify needs and resolve any issues that may arise, ensuring satisfaction while meeting business objectives.

· Collaboration: Collaborate with sales team and other departments to deliver a seamless customer experience.

· Product expertise: Develop and provide a deep technical knowledge of our custom product offerings to guide clients step\-by\-step through their projects.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

· Sales \& Customer Service Expertise: Proven track record in sales, account management, and providing high\-touch customer service.

· Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage clients and stakeholders efficiently.

· Relationship Building: Demonstrate ability to build, maintain, and grow long\- term relationship with clients, especially in a competitive luxury environment.

· Attention to Details: Ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously while maintaining a high level of attention to details and quality.

· Professional Development: Demonstrate willingness to undergo comprehensive training on our complex product line to effectively promote and sell our luxury offerings.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

· Experience with CRM Software and sales reporting tools

· Experience in Luxury Goods \& Services: At least 3\-5 years of experience working in high\-end luxury sector, with deep understanding of luxury products and services.

· Experience in custom window treatments such as draperies, Roman shades, roller shades, etc.

· A deep passion for luxury brands and exceptional service.

Why Join Us?

* Work with a team of highly skilled, passionate employees dedicated to luxury interiors.
* Be part of an elite brand known for exquisite craftmanship and innovation.
* Opportunity to influence and shape the industry at large.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, a cover letter detailing your experience to daniel.galloza@fabritecdesigns.com.

We look forward to discovering your expertise in bringing the world's finest window coverings to life!

Job Type: Full\-time

Schedule:

* Monday to Friday

Work Location: In person

Join us as an Account Manager if you're passionate about technology sales, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and are eager to make a tangible impact through your energetic approach. We value proactive professionals who are committed to excellence in client service while leveraging innovative sales tools for sustained growth.

Pay: $56,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance

jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Company :**  

Cogent Communications is a multinational, Tier 1 facilities\-based ISP, consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world and is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the ticker symbol CCOI. Cogent specializes in providing businesses with high speed Internet access, private network services, IPv4 address leasing, optical transport services and data center colocation services. Cogent's facilities\-based, all\-optical IP network backbone provides IP services in over 228 markets globally. Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end\-to\-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. Structured tenure pay increases and an uncapped commissions plan offers you unlimited earnings potential. Cogent offers a full benefits package including; Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO) (20 days per year), Short and Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, Holidays, Family Leave (three weeks per year), 401(k) plan with employer match, stock options, and an Employee Assistance Program.
  
  

**Compensation:**  

**\[Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range:** \[$19\.23\- $43\.26 per hour or $40,000 – $90,000 per year].
  
  

**Commission:** Commissions are earned on each sale based on product type:
  
  

50% \-150% of one month’s MRCs (monthly recurring charges)
  
  

1/12 of one\-time NRCs (non\-recurring charges) \&
  
  

1/24 of Burst
  
  

**\[Tenured] Base Salary Pay Range:** \[$19\.23 \- $52\.88 per hour or $40,000 \- $110,000 per year] based on achievement of structured tenure based and performance based pay increases.
  
  

Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs.
  
  

**Responsibilities :**  

Identify new business opportunities within a prescribed Regional Sales Territory via sourcing and Hunting to identify new business opportunities within a global sales territory and target market segments of IP Transit, Content creators/hosters, Carriers/wholesalers and Netcentric companies.
  
  

Through direct calling, email and contact efforts you will identify, qualify, and generate these new business opportunities by working directly with Key Decision Makers.
  
  

Compliment prospecting and selling efforts through onsite customer meetings as needed.
  
  

Use consultative and relationship building selling techniques to identify current and future connectivity solutions.
  
  

Help Cogent customers and prospects by positioning our services for new business by leveraging the global network footprint that includes commercial and retail buildings, carrier neutral hotels, data centers and colocation facilities.
  
  

**Qualifications :**  

3\-8\+ years of solid, B2B sales experience in a telecom arena with collocation, wholesale experience and data transit and transport.
  
  

Proven experience with a track record of success in a direct hunting, B2B sales role and quota achievement.
  
  

Demonstrated ability to identify, qualify and generate new business through extensive prospecting and research.
  
  

Strong oral and written communication skills are a must.
  
  

Ability to work in a fast paced, team environment with revenue deadlines.
  
  

Working knowledge of computer applications such as Microsoft Office and a CRM are a plus.
  
  

A college degree is preferred but not required.
  
  

**Work Environment :**  

This is an in\-office position five days a week to best support your success, allowing for focused mentorship, training, and personal coaching
  
  

By submitting an application or resume for this position, I understand that is an in\-office position.
  
  

To apply for the Global Account Manager position, please submit your resume and cover letter to careers@cogentco.com .
  
  

Cogent Communications is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  

\#LI\-WL1
  
\#LI\-Onsite

jobs.title: Clinical Account Manager (Southern California)
jobs.description:
**About Cleerly**



We're Cleerly – a healthcare company that's revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world's leading cardiologists and are a growing team of world\-class engineering, operations, medical affairs, marketing, and sales leaders. We raised $223M in Series C funding in 2022 which has enabled rapid growth and continued support of our mission. In December 2024 we received an additional $106M in a Series C extension funding. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on\-site in a location.



Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value\-based, AI\-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly's solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world's largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person's risk of heart attacks.



At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description.



While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time.

*Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle. Understanding this role's relevance and importance is critical to achieving Cleerly's quality objectives.*

**About the Opportunity**



Our commercial team is growing and looking for a Clinical Account Manager based in Southern California to help support our growth. You will play a critical role in supporting Cleerly's growth and  

success of current clients/partners by making sure they understand our product offerings and  

helping patients get Cleerly scans. Reporting to the Regional Director of Sales, this role will be  

working with clinical partners to find expansion opportunities as well as to provide ongoing  

clinical education to grow existing Cleerly accounts.

  

You will be responsible for identifying growth opportunities, maintaining relationships with  

existing high\-value partners, and representing Cleerly as a leader in the industry to positively  

impact the lives of millions. The ideal candidate is highly motivated, has a clinical background, is  

client focused, result\-oriented, and mission\-driven. You will work with clinics to ensure that they  

are extremely successful with Cleerly's cardiovascular diagnostic technology by proactively  

supporting, educating, and providing high customer satisfaction. This is a customer\- facing role  

with a primary focus on spending time with customers including Cardiologists. This is a  

field\-based role, but you must be based in or near Southern California as it will be a key market in  

your assigned territory: **Southern CA, NV, HI**


**Responsibilities**


* Manage and maintain relationships with clinical partners to make sure they understand  

Cleerly and how Cleerly helps Providers in their treatment decisions for patients.
* Account development \- Experience building and supporting strong clinical programs is  

preferred.
* Clinical / technical proficiency \- Quick learner able to grasp new clinical/technical  

information and then disseminate to customers.
* Develop relationships with key account stakeholders, to include admin, admin support,  

key cardiologists, key referring physician practices, and key strategic personnel to drive  

awareness of Cleerly's offerings and promote adoption.
* Customer\-focused mentality.
* Drive new product and technology introductions for existing customers.
* Develop a qualified lead funnel within the existing base. Regular activities consist of  

formal presentations, peer\-to\-peer education, new physician training, and driving  

physician education.
* Use Salesforce.com to manage administrative tasks.
* Travel to various provider sites within a territory 50\-80% of the time including the following states: **Southern CA, NV, HI**

**Requirements**


* Degree from accredited college/university.
* 5\+ years of related sales **and** clinical experience (PA, NP, DNP or RN).
* Prior experience in medical device, cardiology pharmaceuticals, cardiology  

radio\-pharmaceuticals, hospital, or medical software is highly desired.
* Highly coachable with the ability to learn and communicate complex programs and value  

propositions.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills, polished communications, the ability  

to manage multiple customer and internal company interactions.
* Effective project management skills while embracing change and driving solutions in  

otherwise chaotic environments.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* A hard\-worker, self\-motivator with can\-do approach and bias for action.
* Highly responsive with the ability to interpret appropriate next step actions.
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with both internal and external stakeholders

jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager - Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
Medical Diagnostic Laboratories (MDL), a member of Genesis Global Group, is a CLIA certified clinical laboratory with multiple state licensing, specializing in state of the art, automated DNA based molecular analysis of a variety of chronic and infectious illnesses.
  
  

MDL specializes and performs Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) with a larger menu of testing available in the field of infectious disease. Our main theme of research is in the field of Gynecology, Infectious Diseases, Infectious Arthritis, Tick\-borne Diseases, Mycology, and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (CFS).
  
  

MDL is looking to expand its sales force throughout the U.S. We are seeking a high\-energy, self\-motivated individual to join our sales team. As an Entry Level Account Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining a large client base of existing customers for MDL and serve as a liaison between management and customers to resolve any customer issues.
  
  

**Essential Functions:**  

* Grow client base revenues by presenting new test information, up selling and seeking out new sources of revenue from existing clients
* Establish positive long\-term client relations
* Educate and train clients, research problems and coordinate solutions between the laboratory and client
* Work closely with Senior Sales Executive and Regional Manager to identify client concerns and assist in the development and implementation of client retention strategies
* Monitor, evaluate, and report level of client satisfaction and recommend appropriate corrective action as required
* Maintain knowledge of competitors and their presence in assigned territory


**Job Qualifications:** General Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA’s) required
  
* 1\-3 years of successful customer service experience.
* Well\-developed multi\-tasking, organizational skills, and detail orientation are key to success
* Energy, motivation, enthusiasm, and integrity
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Must demonstrate sound judgment and decision\-making ability
* Computer proficiency in MS Office, Excel, e\-mail and internet functions
* Knowledge of laboratory testing and competing products.
* Must be able to travel within the coverage area and occasionally nationwide


**Physical Demands:** Physical, Mental and Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Use hands to handle, control, or feel objects, tools, or controls
* Ability to sit, stand and walk
* Ability to drive motor vehicle


**Workplace Conditions:** Workplace Environment Conditions
  
* Requires frequent traveling by motor vehicle
* May be exposed to various workplace environments when meeting with customers


**Education and Certifications:**  

* Medical Assistant certification or Associate Degree, BA/BS preferred.


**We Offer:**  

* Uncapped Incentive Payout Plan
* Company Car
* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Life Insurance
* Dependent Care Flex Spending Account
* Voluntary Policies (Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness \& Supplemental STD)
* Identity Theft Protection
* 401(k) Plan
* Paid Vacation \& Holiday
* Business Professional Environment


Visit us at http://www.mdlab.com
  
  

Medical Diagnostic Laboratories, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

The Client Success Representative is an account management role that owns the relationship with a portfolio of QuikStor clients from the completion of initial implementation through the life of the account. jobs.title: Remote Social Media Manager and Content Creator
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced **Freelance Social Media Manager** to support an established hair and beauty business based in Inglewood.

This is a good fit for someone who can take ownership of the social media function, bring ideas to the table, and keep content moving without needing constant direction. We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for content to be handed to them and posts it.

**This is a remote 1099 independent contractor opportunity, not an employee position.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and manage monthly content plans that support consistent daily posting across the brand’s social platforms
* Batch\-create and prepare content in advance to maintain a consistent daily content cadence
* Help identify content themes, campaigns, and opportunities that make sense for the brand
* Contribute ideas and recommendations that strengthen the overall social media direction
* Write engaging captions, calls to action, and other social copy that align with the brand’s voice
* Schedule and publish approved content across relevant social platforms
* Repurpose existing photo and video assets into additional social content
* Plan and communicate what photo and video content should be captured to support upcoming content plans, campaigns, and social media needs
* Create shot lists, content briefs, or other guidance that helps the person responsible for content capture understand what is needed
* Organize social media content and digital assets for easy access and reuse
* Monitor content performance and use insights to improve future content
* Stay aware of relevant social media trends and identify the ones that make sense for the brand
* Communicate proactively about content needs, approvals, priorities, and opportunities

**What We’re Looking For**

You should have demonstrated experience managing social media for a business or brand and be comfortable taking meaningful ownership of your work.

**The ideal candidate:**

* Has professional social media management experience
* Can demonstrate previous work through a portfolio, examples, or relevant accounts
* Understands how brand voice, audience, goals, and positioning should influence content
* Is comfortable developing ideas and making recommendations
* Can work independently while knowing when client input or approval is needed
* Has strong written communication and copywriting skills
* Understands short\-form video and social\-first content
* Understands what makes strong photo and video content for social media and can provide clear direction for content capture
* Is comfortable batching, planning, and scheduling content in advance
* Is organized and able to manage content calendars, deadlines, approvals, and digital assets
* Can interpret basic social media performance data and use it to improve future content
* Is reliable, responsive, and comfortable working directly with a business owner

*Experience with hair, beauty, lifestyle, or other visually driven consumer brands is a plus, but it’s not required.*

**Experience with social media strategy is also a bonus.** While this role is primarily focused on social media management and execution, we’d love someone who can contribute thoughtful ideas, help shape content direction, and make recommendations based on the brand’s goals and performance.

**This May Not Be a Fit If...**

This opportunity may not be the right fit if your experience is primarily limited to scheduling pre\-created posts or you prefer receiving detailed instructions for every piece of content.

We’re looking for someone who can bring strong execution, initiative, creativity, and good judgment to the role.

Pay: Up to $1,600\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Brand Content Producer / Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Location:** Los Angeles, CA  
**Work Type:** Full\-time  
**Salary Range:** $70\-110K  
**Start Date:** Immediate

**About Thyseed (USA)**

Thyseed is a premium baby\-feeding brand focused on helping parents through stressful feeding needs by bringing their babies high quality, trusted baby bottles and other feeding products. We are building our US business from the ground up and are looking for a hands\-on content producer and social media manager who can help make Thyseed’s US content and social media presence be more local, authentic, useful, and emotionally relevant to parents.

**About the Role**

This role will lead Thyseed’s US social media content planning and creation, short\-form video production, static asset production, product storytelling, and day\-to\-day social media platform management. This role is not just about posting content. It is about turning real parent problems into clear, relatable, and high\-performing content.You will help Thyseed communicate with US parents in a natural voice across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, Amazon, DTC, and other digital channels. The ideal candidate understands how to create content that feels native to all platforms, while still supporting business goals like brand awareness, product education, trust\-building, and conversion.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create short\-form video, written, and static design content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Amazon, DTC, and other social or digital platforms.
* Shoot, edit, caption, and package content in a way that feels natural for US parents and social platforms.
* Repurpose content from KOLs, events, parent stories, reviews, and customer feedback into reusable social and ad assets.
* Write ads, product pages, landing pages, and other brand materials.
* Manage Thyseed’s US social content calendar across all key platforms.
* Monitor trends, competitor content, parenting conversations, and creator formats that are relevant to baby feeding and new parents.
* Publish brand\-appropriate content and coordinate posting schedules with internal teams.
* Help build a consistent social voice that is warm, helpful, credible, and parent\-friendly.
* Build online communities for feedback and engagement, develop online and offline events, and respond to user inquiries and comments
* Track social media performance, including views, engagement rates, follower growth, click\-through rate, and sentiment.
* Prepare weekly content updates and regular performance summaries.
* Achieve growth in social reach, engagement, and follower quantity and quality
* Improve US\-native tone and relevance of Thyseed’s digital content

**Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in content creation, social media management, short\-form video production, copywriting, graphic design and other digital content.
* Experience working with consumer brands. Baby, parenting, wellness, beauty, health, family, or premium lifestyle experience is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, creator trends, and US social media behavior.
* Strong video production skills, including planning, shooting, editing, captioning, formatting, and designing digital content.
* Strong writing and static design skills with the ability to create clear hooks, captions, scripts, landing pages, and social copy.
* Able to manage multiple content projects, deadlines, shoots, edits, and feedback rounds at the same time.
* Experience with basic editing and content tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, Canva, Figma or similar tools and able to produce content from start to finish.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume and a short note explaining why you are interested in helping build Thyseed’s US brand. Also include your portfolio with examples of social media content, short\-form videos, UGC\-style content, brand campaigns, landing pages, and graphic designs you have created or managed.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Thyseed is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent legal requirements.

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Location: East Los Angeles, CA, United States  

Date Updated: Sep 4, 2026  

Job ID: 18078


  
**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Territory \& Strategic Business Planning**

* Develop and execute comprehensive, data\-driven territory business plans aligned to brand strategy and launch objectives.
* Analyze territory data (prescribing trends, account potential, access landscape) to identify growth opportunities and prioritize high\-value targets.
* Manage territory budget responsibly, including speaker programs and promotional initiatives.
* Consistently achieve or exceed sales goals and performance metrics.

**Prescriber Activation \& Clinical Engagement**

* Deliver compelling, compliant, and clinically accurate product education within approved labeling.
* Articulate complex clinical data and value propositions tailored to cardiologists, lipid specialists, endocrinologists, and targeted PCPs.
* Differentiate Arrowhead therapies within a competitive and evolving cardiometabolic landscape.
* Execute speaker programs, educational events, and peer\-to\-peer engagements to drive awareness and adoption.
* Support appropriate patient identification and therapy initiation through thoughtful provider engagement.

**Stakeholder \& Account Management**

* Build and sustain strong, trust\-based relationships with healthcare professionals, office staff, and institutional stakeholders.
* Navigate complex health systems and coordinate effectively within IDNs in partnership with Key Account Managers.
* Identify access barriers and collaborate with Market Access and patient services to support pull\-through.
* Maintain consistent, high\-quality engagement and service across accounts to drive durable utilization.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Health IT, and Patient Services to align territory execution with enterprise strategy.
* Provide actionable field insights regarding market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer feedback.

**Compliance \& Operational Excellence**

* Maintain full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and promotional standards.
* Accurately document field activity and manage CRM reporting in a timely manner.
* Demonstrate disciplined execution, accountability, and ethical conduct in all engagements.

**Travel \& Engagement**

* Represent Arrowhead at regional and national meetings, training programs, and key conferences (\~30% travel required).
* Overnight travel may be necessary depending on territory geography.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Qualifications:**

**Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and minimum 5 years of pharmaceutical sales experience required.
* Demonstrated success launching or expanding complex therapies requiring access navigation and clinical depth required.
* 3\+ years in specialty, rare disease, or cardiovascular therapeutic areas strongly preferred.
* Experience working within integrated delivery networks (IDNs) or complex healthcare systems preferred.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong territory planning and account management capabilities with a data\-driven mindset.
* Ability to interpret and communicate complex clinical data confidently and credibly.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.

*Check out more about life at ADT* here.

jobs.title: B2B Sales Representative — Automotive Products
jobs.description:
**About Wagan**

Wagan develops and distributes automotive accessories, portable power products, mobile electronics, and related consumer products. We serve retail, wholesale, e\-commerce, and international customers.

We are looking for a proactive B2B Sales Representative who enjoys finding new customers, building relationships, and developing business through phone calls, email outreach, and face\-to\-face visits.

**The Opportunity**

This position will focus on developing new small and midsize business accounts while supporting Wagan’s existing B2B sales activity.

You will prospect independent automotive stores, hardware stores, specialty retailers, distributors, and other businesses that may benefit from carrying Wagan products. You will contact prospective customers, schedule and conduct visits, present samples, follow up on opportunities, and work toward opening recurring accounts.

This is a hands\-on sales role for someone who is comfortable creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound leads. The position combines inside sales, local field sales, account development, and support for selected established accounts.

**Responsibilities**

* Identify and prospect new small and midsize B2B customers.
* Conduct outbound sales activity through telephone calls, personalized emails, and in\-person visits.
* Develop relationships with independent automotive, hardware, specialty retail, wholesale, and distribution accounts.
* Schedule and conduct local customer visits, bringing samples and presenting appropriate Wagan products.
* Qualify prospects, understand their needs, and recommend suitable products.
* Prepare follow\-up materials, pricing requests, samples, and account\-opening information.
* Maintain a consistent pipeline of prospects and active opportunities.
* Follow up reliably until each opportunity reaches a clear outcome.
* Support the Sales Manager with selected B2B, retail, and international accounts.
* Assist with customer meetings, sales presentations, trade shows, and account visits.
* Coordinate internally with operations, customer service, purchasing, accounting, and marketing.
* Maintain accurate notes, activities, next steps, and forecasts in the company’s sales tracking system.
* Learn Wagan’s product lines and communicate their value clearly to customers.
* Provide market feedback on customer needs, competitive products, pricing, and emerging opportunities.
* Help existing smaller accounts grow through regular contact and additional product placements.

**Qualifications**

* Three or more years of sales, business development, account management, or related customer\-facing experience preferred.
* Demonstrated comfort with cold calling and outbound prospecting.
* Willingness to visit prospective customers and develop business face to face.
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Organized follow\-up habits and the ability to manage multiple opportunities.
* Self\-directed, persistent, and comfortable working toward measurable sales goals.
* Able to build rapport with store owners, buyers, distributors, and business operators.
* Comfortable learning product specifications, pricing, and customer applications.
* Working knowledge of email, spreadsheets, presentations, and CRM or sales\-tracking systems.
* Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and ability to conduct local customer visits.
* Ability to transport and present reasonable quantities of product samples.
* Ability to work from Wagan’s Cerritos office five days per week.
* Spanish fluency is strongly preferred but not required.

**Helpful Experience**

Experience in one or more of the following areas is beneficial:

* Automotive accessories or aftermarket products
* Consumer electronics or portable power
* Hardware, tools, batteries, or outdoor products
* Wholesale or distributor sales
* Independent retail or multi\-location accounts
* Route, territory, or field sales
* Latin American or Spanish\-speaking accounts
* Trade shows and customer presentations

Direct automotive\-industry experience is helpful but not required. We value candidates who have successfully created business through consistent prospecting in adjacent industries.

**What Success Looks Like**

During the first year, a successful representative will:

* Build a disciplined and visible prospecting pipeline.
* Consistently complete calls, emails, visits, and follow\-ups.
* Open new small and midsize accounts.
* Establish recurring business with qualified customers.
* Support selected existing accounts without losing focus on new\-business development.
* Develop strong knowledge of Wagan’s products and target markets.
* Maintain reliable sales records and communicate opportunities clearly.
* Represent Wagan professionally in the office, in the field, and at trade shows.

**Work Environment and Travel**

This is not a remote or hybrid position. The representative will work from Wagan’s Cerritos office five days per week when not conducting approved customer visits or attending business events.

Regular local driving is part of the role. Occasional travel for trade shows, customer meetings, or account development may also be required.

Pay: $24\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Overview:
**If You’re the Best at Sales, You Have a Place with the** **Best in Pests**  

As part of the Orkin Commercial sales team, you get the advantage of a highly persuasive pitch: top\-notch service from an iconic brand name and the industry leader with almost 125 years of protecting homes and businesses. That’s backed by award\-winning training that ensures the professionalism and expertise of all Orkin Pros and the Orkin Guarantee that demonstrates our commitment to customer satisfaction.  

This role combines your competitive drive and your desire to be part of a talented team. You’ll have the opportunity to maximize your financial potential with high\-performance sales skills and contribute to the overall success of the business. And you can earn your way to an annual rewards trip honoring top performers, not to mention chart a path to leadership opportunities.  

You’ll have **more than a job**—you’ll have a **career with growth potential and benefits** that go beyond the basics. This includes a company vehicle, competitive pay and a 401(k) program. Not to mention, you’ll receive **opportunities to volunteer and give back** so that everyone has a safe place to live, work, and play. Work alongside a team that values safety, professionalism, empathy, integrity and innovation in pursuit of our mission to deliver the peace of mind only an Orkin Pro can provide.  

With Orkin’s award\-winning training program, you’ll **receive all the tools you need to succeed**. That means no industry experience required to start building your career. Plus, if there’s one thing we know at Orkin, it’s that pests keep coming back, and that makes our industry recession resistant.  

**Ready to start a career with staying power?** **Apply now!**  


Responsibilities:

As an **Outside Sales Rep**, you’ll be responsible for understanding Orkin’s products and services and how to sell them to a variety of industries. You’ll make strategic recommendations to new and existing customers to help prevent pests, uphold quality and safety, and satisfy their regulatory standards. You’ll solve problems and build trusted relationships as an essential partner protecting their business. Adept at listening to needs and clearly explaining practical solutions, you can win over customers with confidence and care.
**You will…*** Prioritize **safety** in all responsibilities
* Conduct yourself with the utmost **professionalism** and **integrity** with customers and coworkers.
* Serve as an **empathetic** problem solver for commercial customers by utilizing the in\-depth training provided to recommend the best **innovative** overall solution for each customer's needs.
* Achieve sales goals through prospecting new business and assigned leads.
* Utilizing marketing tools to drive new business development.
* Conduct an inspection of the interior and exterior of the customer’s commercial property—don’t worry, we teach you how!
* Make recommendations to customers based on your inspection and issues identified by addressing any questions, explaining the solution, and setting expectations so they have peace of mind about their pest program.
* Use the iPad we provide to prepare sales agreements and help you stay organized—we will provide training on this too!

**We Offer…*** **Estimated first\-year earnings: $60,000 \- $120,000 USD annually**
* **Base plus uncapped commission**
* **Company vehicle with gas card after training is completed**
* Company provided iPhone and iPad with sales software
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, maternity, \& life Insurance
* 401(k) plan with company match, employee stock purchase plan
* Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave
* Employee discounts, tuition reimbursement, dependent scholarship awards
* Industry leading, quality, comprehensive training program

**Why Orkin?*** You’re seeking an opportunity with career potential in a reliable, recession\-resistant industry
* You have a service\-oriented mindset that leads you to build loyalty and trust with customers
* You hold yourself responsible to commitments
* You value being part of a team
* You want to keep learning, improving and developing as a leader
* You want to join a company that supports the community
* **You want a career with a purpose at a mission\-driven company that values**
	+ *Safety*
	+ *Professionalism*
	+ *Empathy*
	+ *Integrity*
	+ *Innovation*


Qualifications:
**Minimum Requirements:*** **No Experience Required!! Sales experience preferred**
* High School Diploma or equivalent required
* Valid driver’s license required
* Ability to obtain the appropriate pesticide license/certification if required (company paid)
* Ability to work in the field independently and interact with our great clients

**Physical Demands / Working Conditions:**


Candidates must meet physical job requirements and safely perform the job duties with or without accommodations:

* Safely use a ladder within the manufacturer's weight capacity
* Occasionally lift and carry up to 50 lbs.
* Safely access crawl spaces, attics, confined spaces, roof tops, etc. including the ability to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
* Wear personal protective equipment (PPE) which sometimes requires an OSHA\-compliant respirator
* Willing to work in different types of weather conditions

 *Orkin is an Equal Opportunity/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities Employer*

jobs.description:
**About Us**

We are a supply chain management and project delivery company specializing in commercial and residential interior projects.

We partner with brands, design firms, real estate developers, and general contractors to provide global sourcing, procurement, and on\-site delivery services for retail display fixtures, custom furniture, custom cabinetry, and decorative materials.

Our services cover the full project lifecycle, including product sourcing, prototyping, production coordination, quality control, logistics management, on\-site installation support, and after\-sales service.

With an established supplier network and collaborative team in China, along with U.S.\-based showrooms, offices, warehouses, operations, and customer service teams, we provide cross\-border, end\-to\-end project delivery solutions.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a highly detail\-oriented, organized, and fast\-learning **Operations \& Office Assistant** to support daily business operations and project execution.

This position combines **project coordination, vendor and client communication, budget tracking, and general office administration**. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with numbers, managing multiple priorities, communicating across teams, and keeping projects organized and on schedule.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to grow in **operations, project coordination, supply chain management, or project management**.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Project Coordination \& Execution**

* Support multiple projects from initiation through completion.
* Prepare, organize, and maintain project documentation, including project plans, schedules, scope documents, and status updates.
* Track project timelines, action items, deadlines, and deliverables.
* Follow up with internal teams and external partners to help keep projects on schedule.
* Assist with day\-to\-day project execution and issue resolution.

**Vendor, Client \& Stakeholder Communication**

* Coordinate communication among project teams, clients, vendors, manufacturers, logistics partners, and subcontractors.
* Follow up on project requirements, production schedules, shipping status, and other project\-related matters.
* Help manage expectations and ensure project information is communicated accurately and promptly.
* Assist with coordinating and negotiating minor vendor or subcontractor terms within authorized limits.

**Budget Tracking \& Cost Control**

* Track project expenses and compare actual costs against budgets.
* Assist with identifying cost variances and maintaining accurate financial records.
* Organize quotations, invoices, purchase\-related documents, and other project financial information.
* Identify potential cost\-saving opportunities and communicate findings to management.

**Office \& Administrative Support**

* Provide general administrative and operational support for the office.
* Organize files, records, reports, and internal documentation.
* Assist with scheduling and coordinating meetings.
* Prepare meeting materials and follow up on action items as needed.
* Support cross\-functional teams with daily operational needs.

**Process Improvement \& Quality Assurance**

* Review existing workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and organization.
* Assist with implementing approved project management procedures and internal processes.
* Review and organize key project deliverables before client submission.
* Help maintain accurate and consistent project documentation and quality standards.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Associate degree or Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Education or experience in **Interior Design, Architecture, Construction, Project Management, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field** is a plus, but not required.
* Fluent in **English and Mandarin Chinese**, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to learn new systems, processes, and industry knowledge quickly.
* Comfortable working with budgets, expenses, quotations, invoices, and numerical data.
* Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Strong communication and follow\-up skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar business software.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
* Willingness to travel to customer or project locations as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience in operations, project coordination, office administration, supply chain, logistics, construction, interior design, or a related environment.
* Experience communicating with vendors, manufacturers, contractors, or logistics providers.
* Basic understanding of project budgeting, purchasing, procurement, or cost tracking.
* Experience working in a cross\-border or international business environment is a plus.

jobs.title: Landscape Account Manager
jobs.description:
**SGD Enterprises dba Four Seasons Landscaping** is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and hands\-on **Landscape Contract Project Manager** to oversee one of our largest and most complex municipal landscape maintenance contracts in the City of Irvine.

This is a high\-level operational position responsible for the **overall performance, staffing, quality control, reporting, and day\-to\-day execution of the contract**. The Project Manager will serve as the central point of accountability for the project and will work closely with company leadership, field supervisors, irrigation personnel, specialty crews, and City representatives to ensure that all contractual requirements are performed consistently, timely, safely, and to the exceptionally high standards expected by the City of Irvine.

This is **not simply an administrative project\-management position**. The successful candidate must have extensive practical knowledge of commercial landscape maintenance and be capable of walking a property, identifying deficiencies, understanding the appropriate corrective action, directing crews, and verifying that the work has been completed correctly.

Position Overview

The City of Irvine contract encompasses a large portfolio of parks and athletic facilities with extensive turf, athletic fields, landscaped planter areas, irrigation systems, environmental services, specialized turf\-management operations, fertilization, pest management, renovation work, and other technical landscape requirements.

Because of the **size, complexity, visibility, and performance expectations of this contract**, we are looking for a Project Manager who understands landscape maintenance at a professional level and can successfully manage both the people and the technical requirements necessary to deliver an exceptional product.

The ideal candidate will be someone who takes ownership of the project, anticipates problems before they become issues, maintains excellent communication with the City, and holds crews and supervisors accountable for consistently meeting contract specifications.

Key Responsibilities

* Assume overall responsibility for the **successful performance of the City of Irvine landscape maintenance contract**.
* Manage and oversee a large workforce consisting of mowing crews, landscape/detail crews, environmental crews, irrigation technicians, IPM personnel, athletic\-field personnel, supervisors, and specialty turf\-renovation crews.
* Develop and maintain weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual work schedules to ensure that **every contractual requirement is completed within the required service frequency and timeframe**.
* Conduct frequent field inspections throughout the City to evaluate landscape quality, turf conditions, athletic fields, planter areas, irrigation performance, cleanliness, and overall contract compliance.
* Ensure that mowing, edging, detailing, pruning, fertilization, aeration, overseeding, topdressing, turf renovation, irrigation maintenance, pest\-management operations, and other specialized landscape activities are performed correctly.
* Coordinate equipment, vehicles, materials, crews, and subcontractors so work is completed efficiently and without interruption.
* Work directly with supervisors and crew leaders to correct deficiencies and improve productivity and quality.
* Manage employee scheduling, attendance, staffing needs, productivity, training, discipline, and overall field performance.
* Ensure sufficient staffing and equipment are available at all times to meet the City's service requirements.
* Oversee specialized **athletic\-field and sports\-turf maintenance**, including reel mowing, aeration, verticutting, deep\-tine aeration, topdressing, interseeding, turf renovation, fraise mowing, sod preparation, and related operations.
* Work closely with irrigation technicians to ensure irrigation systems are operating properly and repairs are completed promptly.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and vendors for specialized work and material deliveries.
* Review contract specifications regularly and ensure field operations remain in full compliance.
* Prepare, complete, review, and submit **all reports, schedules, documentation, inspection records, work logs, service reports, and other information required by the City**.
* Track corrective\-action requests and ensure issues identified by the City are resolved quickly and documented appropriately.
* Attend meetings and site walks with City representatives and company leadership.
* Maintain professional and proactive communication with City staff.
* Monitor material usage, labor productivity, equipment utilization, and overall project efficiency.
* Assist company management with controlling project costs while **never sacrificing the quality or contractual performance expected by the City**.
* Ensure crews comply with all applicable safety requirements, company procedures, and City standards.
* Maintain accurate records relating to staffing, work performed, additional work, materials, equipment, and contract compliance.
* Recognize potential contractual issues or additional\-work opportunities and immediately communicate them to company management.
* Take complete ownership of the project and ensure that issues are followed through **from identification to final resolution**.

Landscape Knowledge Is Essential

This position requires considerably more landscape expertise than a traditional project\-management role.

The Project Manager must have a strong working understanding of areas including:

* Commercial and municipal landscape maintenance
* Sports\-field and athletic\-turf maintenance
* Reel and rotary mowing practices
* Turfgrass identification and management
* Fertilization programs
* Aeration, verticutting, overseeding and topdressing
* Turf renovation and establishment
* Shrub and groundcover maintenance
* Proper pruning techniques
* Weed identification and control
* Integrated Pest Management
* Irrigation tr

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
At T\-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package \- this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth\-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year\-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!


\*\*\* This position may be located anywhere within the Mountain Time or Pacific Time Zones.
  

  

The Client Success Manager at T\-Mobile is a pivotal role focused on enhancing customer relationships and retention within the Government, Strategic, and Enterprise business segments. This position is responsible for managing the entire customer lifecycle, ensuring successful onboarding, product adoption, and continuous value realization. By identifying upsell and cross\-sell opportunities, the Client Success Manager works closely with sales teams to develop strategies that increase account value. Acting as a customer advocate, this role coordinates with multiple departments including sales, engineering, support, and operations to meet contract commitments and resolve issues. Through strategic business reviews and building trusted executive relationships, the Client Success Manager fosters long\-term partnerships and enhances client loyalty.
  

  

This role will support clients that reside on the West Coast of the United States other locations will be considered if they reside in this part of the country.**Job Responsibilities**:

* Customer Relationship Advocacy – Serve as the primary post\-sales point of contact for assigned government and enterprise accounts, advocating for customer needs across internal teams and ensuring a positive end\-to\-end experience. Build and maintain executive\-level relationships with client stakeholders to foster trust, understand business goals, and drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Onboarding Product Adoption – Oversee new customer onboarding and training to guarantee a smooth implementation from Day 0 onward. Educate customers on T\-Mobile for Business products, services, and self\-service tools (e.g. Account Hub) to accelerate product and solution adoption, ensuring clients realize full value from their investments. Develop customer success plans and conduct regular health checks.
* Account Health Monitoring Reviews – Proactively monitor account performance and health indicators (usage trends, service quality, billing, NPS, etc.) to identify signs of risk or opportunity. Lead regular success reviews and QBRs, presenting key performance metrics and insights to client executives. Recommend action plans to address service gaps or evolving needs.
* Issue Resolution Cross\-Functional Coordination – Take ownership of customer issues and coordinate cross\-functional resolution, engaging internal experts to troubleshoot and swiftly resolve problems. Act as the customer champion in internal discussions, documenting interactions and ensuring service levels are met. Drive timely resolutions to maintain operational continuity.
* Retention Renewal Management – Develop and execute strategies to retain customers and secure renewals, mitigating churn. Analyze account health data to identify at\-risk accounts or partial disconnect requests and address root causes proactively. Lead contract renewal processes, negotiate terms, and finalize agreements that maintain or grow revenue.
* Account Growth Upsell – Drive account expansion by identifying and executing cross\-sell and upsell opportunities based on customer needs and usage data. Prepare and present proposals for new solutions, partnering with Sales and Solutions Engineering on complex opportunities that align with customer goals.

 **Education and Work Experience**:

* Bachelor's Degree Business Administration, Management, or related field (Preferred)
* Master's/Advanced Degree Business Administration, Management, or related field (Preferred)
* 4\-7 years Managing customer relationships and account management in business segments such as Government, Strategic, or Enterprise (Required)
* 2\-4 years Coordinating with multiple departments such as sales, engineering, support, and operations to meet contract commitments and resolve issues (Required)
* 2\-4 years Collaborating with sales teams to identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and develop strategies to increase account value (Preferred)

 **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**:

* Client Relationship Management Strong skills in managing client relationships at an executive level, ensuring customer satisfaction and loyalty. (Required)
* Cross Functional Relationships Ability to coordinate with multiple departments such as sales, engineering, support, and operations to meet customer needs and resolve issues. (Required)
* Strategic Thinking Capability to develop strategic plans for customer account growth through upselling and cross\-selling. (Required)
* Problem Solving Proficient in identifying problems and coordinating resources to provide effective solutions. (Required)
* Leadership Experience in leading teams and managing a distributed workforce to achieve business goals. (Required)
* Analytics Ability to analyze customer data to identify trends and opportunities for business improvement. (Required)
* Business Acumen Strong understanding of business operations and the impact of customer success on overall business performance. (Required)
* Telecommunications Knowledge of telecommunications industry, particularly in wireless technologies, to better understand and serve client needs. (Required)

 **Licenses and Certifications**:

* Certified Customer Experience Professional (CCXP): Certification that validates expertise in customer experience management, enhancing skills in customer journey mapping, and strategic alignment to business goals. (Preferred)
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification b
