jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Are you passionate about crafting compelling digital experiences and driving impactful marketing strategies? We are seeking a dynamic **Digital Marketing Specialist** to join our innovative team! In this role, you will lead the development and execution of comprehensive digital marketing campaigns that elevate brand visibility, boost engagement, and generate measurable results. Your expertise in SEO, paid advertising, content creation, and analytics will be instrumental in shaping our online presence and achieving business objectives. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-paced environment where creativity meets data\-driven decision\-making.

**Duties**

* Develop, implement, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels including SEM (Search Engine Marketing), social media advertising, email marketing, and paid search marketing campaigns.
* Manage and monitor paid advertising campaigns using platforms such as Google Ads (Google AdWords), Facebook Advertising, and other social media advertising tools to maximize ROI.
* Conduct keyword research and utilize SEO tools to enhance organic search rankings; optimize website content for search engines using SEO best practices.
* Create engaging content for websites, blogs, social media platforms, and email campaigns that resonates with target audiences.
* Utilize web analytics reporting tools like Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager to track campaign performance, analyze user behavior, and generate actionable insights.
* Manage website content using content management systems such as WordPress; perform website management tasks including updates, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Design visually appealing graphics and multimedia assets using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite to support marketing initiatives.
* Implement marketing automation strategies to nurture leads and improve conversion rates through personalized messaging.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to coordinate digital campaign setup, testing, and performance marketing efforts aligned with business goals.
* Monitor industry trends in digital marketing to continually refine strategies for social media management, web analytics, paid advertising campaigns, and SEO.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in digital marketing with a strong understanding of SEM, SEO, social media marketing, paid advertising campaign management, and web analytics reporting.
* Proficiency with SEO tools, Google Analytics, Google Ads (Google AdWords), Google Tag Manager, and marketing automation platforms.
* Skilled in content creation with a solid grasp of graphic design tools like Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Hands\-on experience managing websites using WordPress or similar content management systems; familiarity with HTML/CSS is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to manage paid advertising campaigns across multiple channels including Facebook Advertising and Google Ads.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data from web analytics tools to inform strategy adjustments.
* Excellent communication skills for creating compelling content and collaborating effectively with team members.
* Technical proficiency in website management, keyword research, performance marketing tactics, and social media management platforms.
* Knowledge of e\-commerce platforms is advantageous for supporting online sales initiatives.

Join us as a Digital Marketing Specialist where your innovative ideas will shape our digital footprint! Bring your enthusiasm for digital strategy combined with technical expertise — together we’ll create impactful campaigns that drive growth and engagement across all channels!

Pay: $26\.24 \- $28\.93 per hour

Expected hours: 5\.0 – 10\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Landscape Project Coordinator: PT with Room for Advancement
jobs.description:
Part\-Time Landscape Project Coordinator

**Rendered Stone Landscapes \| East Bay, CA**  
**Starting at 10\-15 hours/week, with potential to grow to twice that \+**  
**$28\-30/hour to start DOE**

Rendered Stone Landscapes is looking for a **highly organized, reliable, and people\-oriented Project Coordinator** to help coordinate our landscape installation projects and become an important part of our client experience.

This is a part\-time position to start, with approximately **10\-15 hours per week and the potential to grow** to twice that as the role expands. For the first few months, you will work closely with the owners to learn our projects, systems, clients, crew, and standards. As you become comfortable in the role, you will gradually take on more responsibility for day\-to\-day project coordination, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination while continuing to work closely with the ownership team.

**What You'll Do**

You will help guide projects from the beginning of construction through completion, working closely with our clients, field crew, vendors, office team and company owners.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Serving as a primary point of contact for clients during active construction
* Communicating clearly, professionally, kindly, and proactively with clients
* Coordinating schedules, materials, deliveries, subcontractors, and jobsite logistics
* Visiting active jobsites to monitor progress, organization, and quality
* Reviewing plans and ensuring the work being built reflects the approved design and scope
* Maintaining high standards for craftsmanship, details, cleanliness, and overall presentation
* Communicating clearly with the field crew and helping resolve questions or issues as they arise
* Identifying potential problems early and helping develop practical solutions
* Keeping projects organized and on track with established scope, schedule, and cost targets
* Documenting project progress, decisions, changes, and client communication
* Helping coordinate change requests and ensuring work outside the approved scope is properly addressed
* Participating in client meetings, site walks, and project closeouts

You will **not** be responsible for estimating, setting project pricing, budgeting, payroll, or making company financial decisions.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **extremely dependable, organized, communicative, and thoughtful**. You don't need to be a landscape architect or designer, but you do need to understand landscape construction and have a genuine interest in how things are built.

The right person will:

* Have strong practical knowledge of landscape construction, hardscape, irrigation, planting, or related construction
* Be able to read and understand plans and translate them into real\-world construction
* Have exceptionally strong communication skills
* Be comfortable and confident working directly with clients
* Be kind, patient, and professional even and especially when dealing with difficult situations
* Communicate confidently and respectfully with field crews while maintaining clear expectations and a collaborative working relationship
* Have a high standard for craftsmanship and attention to detail
* Notice when something isn't right and be willing to speak up
* Be proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do
* Be highly organized and capable of keeping track of many moving pieces
* Be comfortable taking ownership and following things through to completion
* Understand that the details of the client experience matter just as much as the finished landscape

We are a **small, high\-end boutique landscape design and installation company**, and our clients expect a thoughtful, professional, highly communicative experience. We are looking for someone who naturally understands that standard and can help us maintain it as the company grows.

**Growth \& Training**

This position will begin with approximately **10\-15 hours per week**, with the potential to grow to twice that as responsibilities increase.

Initially, you will **shadow the owner and learn how we manage projects, communicate with clients, work with our crew, and maintain our standards**. As you become familiar with our way of working, you will gradually take on more responsibility for coordinating projects and installations, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination as one of the owners steps back from that role. You will continue to work closely alongside the other owner and our field leadership.

We are looking for someone who is naturally intuitive, observant, and proactive. A good candidate is someone who notices what needs attention, anticipates problems before they become problems, and can often see the next step without having to be told. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build their skills, take on increasing responsibility, and grow with the company over time.

**Why Work With Us**

We are a growing company with a collaborative team culture and a genuine commitment to the people who work with us. We care about doing excellent work, treating people well, and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to learn, contribute, and grow.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding our employee benefits and opportunities, including:

* Competitive hourly compensation
* Performance\-based bonuses
* Employee discounts
* PTO
* Opportunities for advancement and increasing responsibility
* A supportive, collaborative team environment
* A company culture that values communication, respect, craftsmanship, and personal growth
* Benefits currently being developed, including a 401(k) with employer matching and healthcare benefits for eligiible candidates

**Logistical Details**

**Part\-Time**: This position will begin at approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the potential to grow to 20\+ hours per week as the role develops and the needs of the com

**Program Coordinator, San Francisco** 

**Organization:** The Thriving Initiative **Location:** Hybrid (Approximately 75% remote, 25% in\-person)\| San Francisco, CA

**Employment Type:** Part\-Time **Hours:** 10\-15 hours per week **Compensation:** $20–$22 per hour

**Who We Are**

The Thriving Initiative is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit serving survivors on college campuses including San Francisco State University, San Diego State University, and UC Santa Barbara. Our programs are survivor\-centered, trauma\-informed, and grounded in deep respect for community healing.

We are a small but highly committed team. Every staff member is here because they believe in this work. We value innovation, empathy, community, and respect.

**Position Overview**

The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in the day\-to\-day program operations and community\-facing presence of The Thriving Initiative at San Francisco State University (SFSU) and in the broader San Francisco community. This role will support the planning and execution of events and workshops, build and nurture campus and community partnerships, and serve as an accessible point of contact for students seeking resources and connection. The ideal candidate is organized, empathetic, and passionate about improving the lives of survivors. This role reports to the Program Operations Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program \& Event Support**

* Oversee and implement weekly in\-person healing and recovery workshops utilizing diverse alternative forms of healing
* Oversee logistics for events and workshops, including ordering and bringing physical workshop materials, setting up venues, and coordinating with service providers before, during, and after each event.
* Attend weekly staff meetings and a weekly one\-on\-one meeting with the Program Manager
* Works collaboratively with program team to ensure smooth program operations
* Attend and support both on\-campus and off\-campus planned events
* Assist with financial management related to events and workshops, including tracking expenditures and processing orders
* Oversee participant intake and attendance rosters for all sessions
* Assist with additional projects that are assigned

**Student Engagement**

* Directly coordinate all SFSU volunteer engagement activities and oversight.
* Hold regular weekly office hours to provide student volunteers with an accessible, welcoming space to connect, ask questions, and plan activities
* Plan and coordinate bonding activities for student officers to build community and team cohesion
* Draft communication and outreach templates to streamline student officer tasks and outreach efforts
* Empower the volunteer team to create safe, welcoming spaces where survivors feel seen and supported

**Program Outreach** 

* Collaborate with on\-campus partners in planning and delivering programming and events
* Support coordination of tabling events, campus involvement fairs, and promotional flyering across SFSU to drive event attendance
* Closely collaborate with Communications and Outreach coordinator to co\-lead weekly marketing meetings, ensure proper volunteer engagement, and appropriate content creation

**Partnership Development**

* Cultivate and maintain on\-campus partnerships with relevant university departments, student organizations, and offices
* Lead occasional local funding request opportunities
* Foster and strengthen relationships with community partners to expand The Thriving Initiative’s network of support and resources

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Commitment to supporting survivors of interpersonal violence and sexual assault
* Prior involvement in advocacy, social justice, mental health, or survivor support work
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with volunteers, staff, workshop participants, and community partners
* Comfort with basic financial tracking and administrative tasks
* Knowledge of San Francisco State University clubs, organizations, administration, etc.
* Reliable transportation to and from events
* Must be able to transport workshop materials to and from program sites in a timely manner, including loading and unloading supplies up to 25 pounds, reasonable accommodations can be made.

**Preferred**

* Experience in event planning, program coordination, or nonprofit work
* Experience working with or within campus communities
* Bachelors degree or equivalent work experience
* Trauma\-informed training will be provided, but previous mental health experience is a major plus

**Working Conditions**

This is a part\-time, hybrid position with in\-person requirements near San Francisco State University campus. Some off\-campus travel for events and community partnerships may be required. Hours may occasionally vary around events and workshops.

**Compensation \& Work Structure**

* **Pay rate:** $20–$22 per hour
* **Hours:** Approximately 15 hours per week

**Benefits**

* Flexible scheduling
* A highly collaborative, mission\-aligned team environment
* Meaningful professional development and growth opportunities
* The opportunity to contribute directly to survivor\-centered work that creates real change

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Program** **Coordinator**


**Location:** Hybrid; California\-based, with a strong preference for the San Francisco Bay Area  

**Status:** Full\-time, Exempt  

**Reports to:** Senior Program Manager


**Salary** Range: $58,839\-$88,259


**About the Center for Care Innovations**  

The Center for Care Innovations (CCI) is a nonprofit organization working to transform the health care safety net. Our mission is to spark, seed, and spread innovations that strengthen the health and wellbeing of historically underinvested communities.  

  

For more than 25 years, CCI has worked alongside safety net organizations to navigate a changing health care landscape, test new approaches, strengthen organizations and leaders, and help promising ideas spread across the field. Rooted in California, we partner with community health centers, public hospitals, community\-based organizations, managed care plans, public agencies, and philanthropy.  

  

Our work spans capacity\-building initiatives, advising and consulting, and ecosystem development: running intensive learning collaboratives and accelerators, providing tailored advising and research, and hosting cross\-sector gatherings. These bring people together to tackle some of the health care safety net's most pressing challenges.  

  

For more information, please see the www.careinnovations.org (http://www.careinnovations.org/).
  

  

**About the Program Coordinator Role**


CCI is looking for a collaborative, proactive, and organized Program Coordinator to support initiatives that help health care safety net organizations improve care and advance health equity. This is a great role for someone who has experience supporting complex initiatives and enjoys keeping many moving pieces organized, anticipating what different stakeholders need, and creating a thoughtful experience for participants and partners.  

  

You'll work across multiple CCI initiatives and team configurations, building your experience in project management, health systems improvement, events and learning experiences, and partner engagement. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work while thriving as part of a collaborative, matrixed team.  

  

**What** **You'll Do**


* **Keep multiple initiatives organized and moving forward.** Coordinate day\-to\-day activities across multiple initiatives, tracking tasks, timelines, milestones, and deliverables. Maintain work plans and knowledge management systems, anticipate needs, and help ensure important details don't fall through the cracks.


* **Coordinate meetings and keep teams connected.** Manage scheduling, prepare agendas, presentations, reports, participant resources, and other materials, take notes, and document and track action items across internal and external meetings.


* **Create seamless and welcoming participant experiences.** Serve as a responsive point of contact for participants and partners, anticipate their needs, communicate clearly and warmly, and troubleshoot issues throughout CCI initiatives.


* **Coordinate high\-quality in\-person and virtual events.** Partner to plan and host highly interactive convenings, workshops, conferences, and other learning experiences. Coordinate venues, vendors, registration, participant communications, speakers, materials, on\-site logistics, and virtual platforms such as Zoom.


* **Support communications and learning materials.** Draft participant communications, newsletters, presentations, and other resources, and coordinate with CCI colleagues on initiative webpages, external communications, and learning materials.


* **Use data to support learning and improvement.** Maintain accurate participant and engagement data, including attendance, satisfaction surveys, and other initiative information in Salesforce and CCI's other tracking systems. Gather and synthesize participant feedback, prepare reports and summaries, and help teams identify trends, successes, and opportunities for improvement.


* **Support grants, contracts, and initiative finances.** Track deliverables, contracts, invoices, expenses, and related documentation in partnership with initiative leads.


**You Might Be a Great Fit If You...**

**About the Role**

The Asset Production Assistant is responsible for supporting the Asset Production Coordinator and Catalog Creative team by processing incoming photography, building catalog layouts, and finalizing product and editorial copy through several rounds of proofs. The role requires a can\-do attitude, flexibility, and ongoing communication with multiple internal and external partners to produce seasonal catalogs and assist with season launches.  



**Essential Functions**

* Build layouts in InDesign using pre\-existing brand templates for image and copy intensive catalog spreads.

jobs.title: Catering and Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
*The mission of St. Francis Yacht Club is to serve as the inspirational center*


*of boating activities regionally, and a leader of yachting internationally.*

*We honor camaraderie, sportsmanship, tradition and the maritime heritage*


*of San Francisco in a premier yachting environment.*

  

**Club Overview**

  

Founded in 1927, St. Francis Yacht Club is steeped in over 90 years of yachting traditions. From the beginning, St. Francis Yacht Club?s membership has included many of the Bay Area?s most prominent citizens and greatest sailors. The Club?s annual regatta schedule is one of the most active in the world. Both physically beautiful and naturally demanding, the Bay provides a racer with the ultimate in wind, current and weather conditions for truly competitive, exciting sailing.


Adjacent to the Marina District, the clubhouse provides a boating and social venue for members and their guests, featuring deep\-water guest docks, outstanding dining amenities and incredible vistas of the Golden Gate Bridge and San Francisco Bay. The Club boasts a professional staff, excellent dining rooms, inviting bars and spectacular private party facilities, not to mention extensive experience in accommodating regattas of all kinds and sizes.


In addition to the city\-based clubhouse, Tinsley Island is our private slice of paradise, located 60 miles up the Delta from St. Francis Yacht Club. This 40\-acre oasis is accessed by a Club\-owned launch or private boat and offers a year\-round getaway for our members, featuring dockage and houseboats, on\-island lodging and kitchen facilities, a swimming pool, small boat fleet for member use and a variety of other diversions in a rustic, relaxing setting.

  


**Position:** Catering and Events Coordinator

The Catering and Events Coordinator collaborates with culinary, food and beverage, and supports teams, as well as approved vendors, to ensure the seamless execution of all events. jobs.title: Office Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About WCN**


Wildlife Conservation Network is a rapidly growing leader in wildlife conservation, protecting endangered wildlife by supporting conservationists who ensure wildlife and people coexist and thrive. Using a collaborative, entrepreneurial, innovative, and philanthropically generous approach, WCN gives conservation leaders access to the donors, resources, and tools they need to reverse the crises facing threatened species — raising philanthropic funding and channeling it to a vetted network of Conservation Partners and through species\-focused Wildlife Funds that support over 125 species in more than 50 countries.

**Position Summary**


The Office Operations Coordinator keeps WCN's office, facilities, technology, events logistics, and finance\-support functions running day to day. This is a generalist role by design — the person in it moves across a wide range of tasks and prioritizes what's most urgent on a given day — and it's a strong entry point into nonprofit operations for someone early in their career who wants to grow. Reporting to the CFO, this role supports the whole organization and works most visibly alongside Donor Engagement and Events around Expo and other donor\-facing events. This role is anticipated to be in\-office full time.

**Mission, Vision \& Values Alignment**


This role keeps the operational backbone of WCN — office, technology, events, and finance\-support functions — running smoothly, freeing the organization to focus on its Conservation Partners, Wildlife Funds, and Rising Wildlife Leaders work in the field. It lives WCN's values directly: *Service* (the role exists to support other teams' work), *Integrity* (trustworthy handling of financially sensitive tasks like check deposits and petty cash), *Community* (visitor hospitality and internal culture/engagement support), and *Collaboration* (close partnership with Finance, Donor Engagement, and Events).

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Office \& Facilities** — Keep the physical office running day to day: phone coverage, visitor reception, supplies and systems, vendor relationships (e.g., janitorial), and a well\-organized, well\-used physical space.
* **Administrative Support** — Keep WCN organized and staff supported: general inquiries, mail, filing, new\-hire onboarding logistics, shared calendars, and employee engagement activities.
* **Finance Support** — Own the day\-to\-day financial tasks that keep operations running cleanly: check deposits (primary owner), petty cash, vendor invoices and payments, subscription tracking, and monthly credit card reconciliation, in close partnership with the Finance team.
* **Technology \& Equipment** — Maintain WCN's computer/equipment inventory and serve as the primary point of contact with WCN's IT support vendor.
* **Events \& Cross\-Team Support** — Coordinate staff and partner travel bookings and expense reporting, and support logistics for internal and external events, including Expo (storage, merchandise, partner packages).
* **Ad Hoc** — Take on cross\-departmental administrative support and special projects (Development, Programs, Finance) as they come up.

**Qualifications**

* 1\-3 years of office/administrative experience
* Strong general computer and technology skills (e.g., spreadsheets, documents, presentation software)
* Experience with cloud\-based collaborative tools (Google Drive, email); willingness to learn Salesforce basics with training
* Experience answering/routing calls on a multi\-line phone system or serving in a front\-desk/reception role
* Experience coordinating with vendors or service providers (scheduling, ordering, basic contract/invoice tracking)
* Familiarity with mail/shipping logistics (USPS, UPS, FedEx)
* Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills
* Comfortable with variety and frequent interruptions (phones, visitors, vendors) rather than sustained single\-task focus; self\-directed enough to keep a long list of recurring tasks moving without close daily supervision
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds and sit for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation
* Genuine interest in wildlife conservation and strong alignment with WCN's Core Values

**Compensation \& Benefits**


Compensation is expected to be in the $33\-36 an hour range based on qualifications and experience. Benefits include: medical, dental, and vision insurance contributions; chiropractic/acupuncture; basic life insurance and AD\&D Health FSA and dependent care (pre\-tax); a retirement plan with a 100% employer match on employee contributions up to 6% of salary; 11 paid holidays plus 1 paid floating holiday; 15 days of paid vacation in the first year (\+1 day per year worked); paid sick leave; and employee wellness, mental health, and discount programs.

**Equal Opportunity**


WCN is committed to the principles of being an equal opportunity employer (EOE). WCN’s organizational policies, practices, programs, activities and decisions regarding employment are not based on a person’s race, color, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, parental status, housing status, or other protected status, in accordance with applicable law. Black, Indigenous, people of color, women, individuals identifying with the LGBTQIA\+ community, or members of other underrepresented groups in the conservation sector are strongly encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator 2
jobs.description:
Stanford University's Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Spine Division is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Clinical Research Coordinator 2 (CRC2\) to support the research program. This position plays a central and independent role in managing all aspects of PI’s research portfolio, including industry\-funded clinical trials, multi\-site collaborations, registry studies, and grant\-funded projects including PI\-Initiated projects. The CRC2 serves as the primary research contact for sponsors, collaborators, IRBs, and internal stakeholders, and will work closely with surgical faculty, residents, fellows, and students.


This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced research professional seeking meaningful responsibility in a dynamic academic medical center environment.


Must possess and maintain a valid California non\-commercial Class C Driver’s License.


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS\*:**

* Ability to drive day or night.
* Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping.
* Occasionally sit, reach above shoulders, perform desk based computer tasks, use a telephone and write by hand, lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh up to 40 pounds.
* Rarely kneel, crawl, climb ladders, grasp forcefully, sort and file paperwork or parts, rarely lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh 40 pounds or more.

*\* \- Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.*

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* Position may at times require the employee to work with or be in areas where hazardous materials and/or exposure to chemicals, blood, body fluid or tissues and risk of exposure to contagious diseases and infections.
May require extended or unusual work hours based on research requirements and business needs  
* 

**WORK STANDARDS:**

* When conducting university business, must comply with California Vehicle Code and Stanford University driving requirements.
* Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates the ability to work well with Stanford colleagues and clients and with external organizations.
* Promote Culture of Safety: Demonstrates commitment to personal responsibility and value for safety; communicates safety concerns; uses and promotes safe behaviors based on training and lessons learned.
* Subject to and expected to comply with all applicable University policies and procedures, including but not limited to the personnel policies and other policies found in the University's Administrative Guide, http://adminguide.stanford.edu .

  
**Core Duties** :


* Oversee subject recruitment and study enrollment goals. Determine effective strategies for promoting/recruiting research participants and retaining participants in long\-term clinical trials.
* Oversee data management for research projects. Develop and manage systems to organize, collect, report, and monitor data collection. Extract, analyze, and interpret data.
* Develop project schedules, targets, measurements, and accountabilities, as assigned. Lead team meetings and prepare/approve minutes.
* Formally supervise, train, and/or mentor new staff or students, as assigned, potentially including hiring, preparing or assisting with the preparation of performance evaluations, and performing related duties, in addition to instruction on project work.
* Audit operations, including laboratory procedures, to ensure compliance with applicable regulations; provide leadership in identifying and implementing corrective actions/processes. Monitor Institutional Review Board submissions and respond to requests and questions.
* Collaborate with principal investigators and study sponsors, monitor and report serious adverse events, and resolve study queries.
* Provide leadership in determining, recommending, and implementing improvements to policies/processes; define best practices.
* Develop study budget with staff and principal investigator, identifying standard of care versus study procedures. Track patient and study specific milestones, and invoice sponsors according to study contract.
* Ensure regulatory compliance. Regularly inspect study documents to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
Work with principal investigator to ensure Investigational New Drug applications are submitted to the FDA when applicable. Ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed.  
* 

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in a related field and two years of experience in clinical research, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and database applications.
* Experience with research protocols and regulatory or governing bodies, which include HIPAA and FDA regulations, Institutional Review Board requirements, and Good Clinical Practices.
Knowledge of medical terminology.  
* 

**Certificates and Licenses Required**

Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification is preferred.

jobs.description:
**About Cleerly**



We're Cleerly – a healthcare company that's revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world's leading cardiologists and are a growing team of world\-class engineering, operations, medical affairs, marketing, and sales leaders. We raised $223M in Series C funding in 2022 which has enabled rapid growth and continued support of our mission. In December 2024 we received an additional $106M in a Series C extension funding. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on\-site in a location.



Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value\-based, AI\-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly's solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world's largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person's risk of heart attacks.



At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description.



While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time.

*Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle. Understanding this role's relevance and importance is critical to achieving Cleerly's quality objectives.*

**About the Opportunity**



Our commercial team is growing and looking for a Clinical Account Manager based in Northern California to help support our growth. You will play a critical role in supporting Cleerly's growth and  

success of current clients/partners by making sure they understand our product offerings and  

helping patients get Cleerly scans. Reporting to the Regional Director of Sales, this role will be  

working with clinical partners to find expansion opportunities as well as to provide ongoing  

clinical education to grow existing Cleerly accounts.

  

You will be responsible for identifying growth opportunities, maintaining relationships with  

existing high\-value partners, and representing Cleerly as a leader in the industry to positively  

impact the lives of millions. The ideal candidate is highly motivated, has a clinical background, is  

client focused, result\-oriented, and mission\-driven. You will work with clinics to ensure that they  

are extremely successful with Cleerly's cardiovascular diagnostic technology by proactively  

supporting, educating, and providing high customer satisfaction. This is a customer\- facing role  

with a primary focus on spending time with customers including Cardiologists. This is a  

field\-based role, but you must be based in or near Southern California as it will be a key market in  

your assigned territory: **Northern CA**


**Responsibilities**


* Manage and maintain relationships with clinical partners to make sure they understand  

Cleerly and how Cleerly helps Providers in their treatment decisions for patients.
* Account development \- Experience building and supporting strong clinical programs is  

preferred.
* Clinical / technical proficiency \- Quick learner able to grasp new clinical/technical  

information and then disseminate to customers.
* Develop relationships with key account stakeholders, to include admin, admin support,  

key cardiologists, key referring physician practices, and key strategic personnel to drive  

awareness of Cleerly's offerings and promote adoption.
* Customer\-focused mentality.
* Drive new product and technology introductions for existing customers.
* Develop a qualified lead funnel within the existing base. Regular activities consist of  

formal presentations, peer\-to\-peer education, new physician training, and driving  

physician education.
* Use Salesforce.com to manage administrative tasks.
* Travel to various provider sites within a territory 50\-80% of the time including the following states: **Northern California**

**Requirements**


* Degree from accredited college/university.
* 5\+ years of related sales **and** clinical experience (PA, NP, DNP or RN).
* Prior experience in medical device, cardiology pharmaceuticals, cardiology  

radio\-pharmaceuticals, hospital, or medical software is highly desired.
* Highly coachable with the ability to learn and communicate complex programs and value  

propositions.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills, polished communications, the ability  

to manage multiple customer and internal company interactions.
* Effective project management skills while embracing change and driving solutions in  

otherwise chaotic environments.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* A hard\-worker, self\-motivator with can\-do approach and bias for action.
* Highly responsive with the ability to interpret appropriate next step actions.
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with both internal and external stakeholders

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), cloud technical support, cloud escalation management, or cloud consulting.
* Ability to communicate in Mandarin and English fluently to support the client relationship management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master’s degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, problem\-solving, and client management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers successfully adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the successful adoption of Google Cloud at organizations, guiding them through the strategic and technical facets of their Google Cloud transformation journey. You will manage the successful delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive customer adoption of Google Cloud services. In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including leadership of enterprises and a cross\-functional and geographically dispersed team.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $140000 \- $204000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Accelerate customer adoption of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goal and business transformation strategies.
* Advocate for customer needs in order to overcome adoption blockers and drive new feature development. Lead across multiple work streams and teams to maintain customer momentum.
* Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand customer’s business, develop strategic roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to better understand business and technical needs.
* Plan for customer events and launches, partnering with Support, Engineers, and Site Reliability Engineers to ensure customer success, and work with customers and Support to guide issues/escalations to resolution.
* Develop best practices and assets based on learnings from customer engagements to support initiatives to scale through partners and accelerate Google Cloud adoption.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
Sales Department*Job Description* **Position Summary:** Mirapath is looking for a goal\-oriented Territory Account Manager to cultivate and expand our footprint in the South Central territory. This role focuses on acquiring new business logos, generating a robust sales pipeline, fostering connections with potential clients, and growing strategic current accounts.
The ideal candidate will have existing industry ties in AI infrastructure, data centers, enterprise IT, colocation, or critical facilities, along with a history of sourcing and securing new ventures independently. This is a field\-based remote role. **Work Arrangement**: On\-site, Hybrid \& Remote

**Multiple Locations**: CA, MN, TX, VA

**Compensation**: Competitive Base Salary \+ Uncapped Commission (60/40 OTE Split \+ Performance Accelerators)**Position Responsibilities**
=============================

**Sales \& Revenue Growth**
===========================

* **Own new\-logo acquisition and revenue growth across the assigned territory.**
* Develop and execute a territory plan that identifies priority markets, target accounts, key stakeholders, partner relationships, and near\-term opportunities.
* Build and maintain a self\-generated pipeline through existing relationships, direct prospecting, referrals, industry associations, manufacturer and partner networks, events, phone, email, LinkedIn, and coordinated marketing activities.
* Drive sales for assigned accounts by building rapport, understanding account requirements, explaining product/service capabilities, negotiating contract terms, and finalizing contracts
* Expand sales (upsell) in assigned accounts by introducing new products and services
* Initiate sales process by scheduling appointments, making initial presentations, and understanding account requirements
* Recommend new products and services by evaluating current product results and identifying needs to be filled
* Monitor competition by gathering current marketplace information on pricing, products, new products, delivery schedules, and merchandising techniques
* Participate in team meetings and take responsibility for sales improvement initiatives

**Client Relationship Management**
----------------------------------

* **Build and maintain strong client relationships**
* Manage and resolve client concerns/issues during the entire sales cycle
* Provide product and pricing information by clarifying customer requests, selecting appropriate information, and answering questions
* Develop multithreaded relationships with data center, IT, network, facilities, engineering, procurement, operations, and executive stakeholders.
* Provide quality customer service in assisting customers on questions and/or requests
* Represent Mirapath at customer meetings, industry events, partner engagements, and regional networking opportunities.
* Explain the scope of all solutions and position them in relation to an organization's requirements

**Cross\-Functional and Internal Collaboration**
------------------------------------------------

* **Communicate, liaise, and negotiate internally and externally to facilitate the development of profitable business and sustainable relationships**
* Lead the complete sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through solution development, proposal, negotiation, closing, and post\-sale account expansion.
* Keep management informed by submitting activity and results reports
* Develop and tailor materials to assist the sales team in explaining key features \& benefits
* Work collaboratively and productively with other departments to meet customer needs
* Create processes that improve efficiencies and gather consensus and buy\-in from those involved

**Additional Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* **Maintain all aspects of client records, including meeting notes and activities, in CRM database**
* Provide regular territory forecasts, pipeline updates, competitive intelligence, and account\-development plans to sales leadership.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of Mirapath's product set; participate in educational opportunities
* Attend internal meetings, exhibitions, and events as required
* Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed

 **Position Requirements*** BA/BS in a business or technical related field or equivalent combination of education and experience required. MBA a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience selling relevant and related products; experience with data center/IT infrastructure products a plus.
* Proficient computer, software, and data analysis skills (Salesforce.com/CRM, Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
* Demonstrate strong initiative, resiliency, organizational and time management skills
* Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Excellent problem solver with strong negotiation and presentation skills
* Proven record in business development and account planning/management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Resourceful and ability to adapt quickly to changing environment
* Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage time within a fast\-paced environment
* Travel up to 25% of the time

jobs.description:

Muirlands
**Number of Units:**

350
**About Fairfield**
===================

If you're driven and looking for a collaborative workplace that makes a difference, you just might be a fit for Fairfield! We are a leader in the multifamily housing industry and we're passionate about creating exceptional apartment living. As we continue to grow, we're dedicated to investing in our people. Our culture is built on trust, support, and the drive to do great work. Whether you're launching your career or bringing years of experience, you'll find opportunities to make an impact, develop your skills, and be part of something bigger. Come build your future with us!


**About the Role**
==================

As an Assistant Community Manager – Affordable, you’ll play a key role in supporting property operations, ensuring compliance with affordable housing programs, and delivering exceptional customer service. This position is ideal for someone ready to take the next step in property management while mentoring leasing teams and driving resident satisfaction.


**What You'll Do**
==================

**Accounting \& Reporting**

* Collect and post rent, process invoices, and prepare monthly financial reports.
* Complete bank deposits and account reconciliations.
* Use Yardi software to manage property financials.

**Affordable Housing Compliance**

* Verify income and monitor rent limits for LIHTC and/or HUD programs.
* Prepare for inspections and maintain housing authority relationships.

**Customer Service \& Leasing**

* Lease apartments and respond to resident inquiries promptly.
* Promote resident satisfaction and retention.

**Team Collaboration**

* Mentor leasing team members and support the Community Manager in daily operations.

**Why You'll Love Fairfield**
=============================

We're all about creating communities that people are proud to call home. Being a part of Fairfield means more than a rewarding career with personal growth. It's a partnership, working alongside colleagues in an open\-dialogue environment that encourages growth and the sharing of ideas. We know that our associates are a key ingredient to our success, and we're proud to reflect that in our culture.


* **Driven by Vision** : We are a vertically integrated operator and investment manager in the multifamily sector with in\-house development, construction, acquisition, and property and asset management services. As we continue to grow, we want you to grow with us.
* **Career Growth \& Learning** : Fairfield values new ideas at every level. We offer training, coaching, and mentoring to help associates develop their careers and inspire them to create change for the better.
* **Culture of Collaboration** : Enjoy a professional, supportive environment where we work together to drive meaningful impact.
* **A Company that Cares** : We are proud to offer robust benefit packages with a focus on both quality of care and affordability. We offer competitive compensation plans, 401(k) matching, and paid time off, including sick days and volunteer time off (VTO) to support causes that matter to you.

==========================

* Minimum of one year of residential leasing, sales, and/or property management experience required.
* Minimum of one year of LIHTC experience required.
* Experience in leadership and supervising a staff preferred.
* Experience using Yardi or other related property management accounting software.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel.
* Strong math and accounting skills.
* Understanding of financial statements (budget, financial reports, accounting information, etc.).
* Strong understanding of federal, state, and local fair housing laws and provisions.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Housing Credit Certified Professional (HCCP) designation preferred.
* Knowledge of Low Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC).
* Knowledge of IRS 8823 guide and HUD 4350\.3 manual.

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------


Credit Genie is a mobile\-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long\-term financial stability.

  

Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017\). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting\-edge technology and customer\-centric solutions.

**Overview:**

As an Integrated Marketing Lead at Credit Genie, you will be responsible for owning how our brand shows up across every channel our audience touches. This is a broad, senior individual\-contributor role that brings brand marketing, social media, and influencer marketing under one roof, with the ownership to set strategy and execute it.


You will be the connective tissue across marketing: shaping our brand narrative, running an always\-on and campaign driven social presence, owning our influencer and creator program end to end, leading PR and communications, and orchestrating integrated campaigns that move people from awareness to consideration to adoption. You will partner closely with growth, design, product, customer service, and the people team to translate Credit Genie's mission into work that builds awareness, drives consideration, and earns lasting loyalty.

**What You'll Do:**


You will be the connective tissue across marketing: shaping our brand narrative, running an always\-on and campaign driven social presence, owning our influencer and creator program end to end, leading PR and communications, and orchestrating integrated campaigns that move people from awareness to consideration to adoption. You will partner closely with growth, design, product, customer service, and the people team to translate Credit Genie's mission into work that builds awareness, drives consideration, and earns lasting loyalty.

* **Be a brand ambassador.** Act as a champion and guardian of the Credit Genie brand executing our positioning, voice, and visual identity consistently across every touchpoint, and building brand awareness and consideration through on\-brand creative and brand\-building programs, including brand campaigns across channels such as OOH, video, and digital.
* **Build and own social strategy.** Establish Credit Genie's social media strategy from the ground up and own it end to end across all major platforms. Partner with the design team to develop campaigns, manage the content pipeline and editorial calendar, maintain a consistent brand presence, and tailor content to the strengths and audience of each platform.
* **Own influencer and creator marketing end to end.** Own the strategy and execute the full program: sourcing, vetting, briefing, contracting, content review, and reporting. Turning partnerships into organic growth in following and recognition.
* **Build the employer brand.** Partner with the people team to tell Credit Genie's story as a place to work. Culture and employee content that attracts talent and a strong presence on platforms like LinkedIn and Glassdoor.
* **Own integrated go\-to\-market.** Translate business goals into integrated campaigns that span brand, social, influencer, PR, OOH, and lifecycle channels — owning them from concept through launch and optimization as one coherent story.
* **Be the voice of our community.** Engage customers across social networks, nurture our communities, and protect brand sentiment.
* **Drive PR and communications.** Lead media relations, press materials, and announcement plans; secure earned coverage; and support launches, milestones, and issues and reputation management with leadership and legal.
* **Lead across the company.** Align partners across growth, design, product, customer service, and people, influencing cross\-functional teams without direct authority to deliver business outcomes and keep the brand consistent everywhere.
* **Measure, experiment, and optimize.** Define KPIs, run tests, and turn results and consumer insight into recommendations that shape strategy and investment — using web and social analytics tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Google Analytics, Sigma).

 **Requirements:**

* 7\+ years of experience leading all aspects of social strategy across major platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, and YouTube.

**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

jobs.description:
Global Real Estate and Workplace Experience (GREWE) is a global team at American Express (Amex) responsible for the full lifecycle of planning, execution, and operations of Amex real estate. GREWE supports over 75,000 Amex colleagues and contractors in over eight million square feet of property located in 59 countries.


GREWE’s purpose is to provide the world’s best workplace experience at a competitive cost, for every colleague, at every site, every day.


The GREWE Property Development team is responsible for delivering a new global headquarters from concept to completion. They lead the full lifecycle of the project—overseeing design, coordinating construction, managing stakeholders, and ensuring the building is fully prepared for operations. This team is responsible for ensuring the headquarters is delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with organizational goals and future workplace needs.


**How will you make an impact in this role?**

The Document Controller will serve as the owner\-side lead for document control on American Express new Headquarters project in New York City, supporting both Base Build and Interiors delivery. This role will establish, administer, and enforce a disciplined document management process across the owner, developer, design, construction, consultant, and agency teams. The successful candidate will bring direct experience with large\-scale development environments, including Port Authority interfaces, QAD\-related documentation, and complex developer\-led project delivery.


  
**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Experience as a Document Controller, Document Control Manager, Project Administrator, or similar role supporting large\-scale design and construction projects in New York City.
* Direct experience supporting owner\-side, developer\-side, or owner's representative project delivery organizations.
* Demonstrated experience controlling documentation for both Base Build and Interiors scopes, including management of interface risks between building infrastructure and tenant fit\-out requirements.
* Strong knowledge of document control processes for drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, transmittals, meeting records, change documentation, inspection reports, closeout documentation, and turnover packages.
* Experience coordinating documentation associated with Port Authority reviews, QAD processes, authority submissions, or comparable agency\-driven review workflows.
* Strong understanding of document naming conventions, revision control, metadata management, access permissions, distribution controls, audit trails, and records retention requirements.
* Proficiency with project collaboration and document management platforms such as Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Procore, SharePoint, Bluebeam, or comparable systems.
* Ability to work effectively with owners, developers, architects, engineers, construction managers, trade partners, legal teams, consultants, and operations stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, confidentiality, and professional judgment when handling sensitive project information.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to prepare concise and accurate reporting for senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting mega projects, headquarters developments, transportation\-oriented developments, public\-private projects, or major commercial office developments in New York City.
* Prior experience working directly with Port Authority requirements, QAD review processes, developer governance frameworks, or authority\-facing submission workflows.
* Experience supporting both Core \& Shell and Interiors programs simultaneously within a complex development environment.
* Experience working within an owner's representative, developer, construction management, architecture, engineering, or program management environment.
* Advanced reporting and analytics capabilities, including development of document tracking dashboards and executive status reports.
* Familiarity with project controls, schedule management, procurement, risk management, change management, commissioning, and turnover processes.
* Ability to establish and continuously improve document control procedures, templates, workflows, folder structures, governance requirements, and training materials.
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, Real Estate Development, Information Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

**Success in this Role**
------------------------

Success in this role will be measured by:


* Maintaining a complete, accurate, and auditable project record for executive decision\-making and governance.
* Ensuring Base Build and Interiors teams operate from coordinated, current, and controlled project documentation.
* Achieving timely tracking and closure of Port Authority, QAD, consultant, contractor, and developer document review cycles.
* Supporting risk reduction, schedule adherence, audit readiness, project closeout, and successful transition to operations.

This role is suited for a highly organized, detail\-oriented professional who can bring structure, discipline, and accountability to project information management across a complex, multi\-billion\-dollar development program.

jobs.title: Middle School After-School Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Rooted in the Bronx, New Settlement stands with community members to break systemic barriers, advance justice, promote leadership and strengthen neighborhoods. By ensuring agency around education, employment, housing, wellness and creative expression, we help cultivate an equitable society where individuals and families have the power to use their voice to create the change they wish to see.


Since New Settlement’s inception in 1989 as a settlement house rooted in the Bronx, our organization has been a responsive community partner. Originally established to revitalize abandoned buildings into affordable housing, New Settlement has since evolved into a multi\-generational, forward\-looking organization. We support 15,000 members of the community annually by providing organizing in housing and schools, and programs in education, college access, youth development, arts, workforce development, wellness and more. EEO/AA

**JOB SUMMARY:** The Middle School After\-School Program Coordinator is responsible for supporting the daily operations, implementation, and quality assurance of a DYCD\-funded after\-school program serving students in grades 6–8\. The coordinator works closely with the Associate Division Director to ensure compliance with all New York City Department of Youth and Community Development (DYCD) requirements while providing a safe, engaging, and enriching environment for participants. The coordinator supervises program staff, supports youth development initiatives, fosters positive relationships with school personnel and families, and ensures the successful delivery of academic, recreational, leadership, and enrichment activities.




**Job Duties include but not limited to**:




**Program Operations:**

* Assist in the daily management and oversight of after\-school program operations.
* Ensure program activities are implemented according to DYCD standards, contractual requirements, and organizational policies.
* Coordinate participant enrollment, attendance tracking, and roster management.
* Monitor program schedules to ensure activities begin and end on time.
* Support the planning and execution of special events, trips, showcases, and family engagement activities.
* Assist with site coverage and supervision during program hours.

**Staff Supervision and Development:**

* Provide direct supervision, coaching, and support to group leaders, activity specialists, and support staff.
* Conduct classroom observations and provide constructive feedback.
* Facilitate staff meetings and professional development sessions as assigned.
* Ensure staff maintain high standards of youth engagement, behavior management, and program quality.
* Support staff with lesson planning and curriculum implementation.

**Youth Development:**

* Foster a positive, inclusive, and safe environment that promotes social\-emotional learning, leadership development, and youth voice.
* Support implementation of evidence\-based curricula and enrichment activities.
* Address participant behavioral concerns using restorative and positive youth development practices.
* Build meaningful relationships with youth and families.

**Compliance and Data Management:**

* Ensure accurate collection and maintenance of attendance, participant records, incident reports, and required DYCD documentation.
* Monitor compliance with DYCD, Department of Health (DOH), Department of Education (DOE), and organizational regulations.
* Assist with audits, site visits, and program monitoring reviews.

Flatbush Cats is a Brooklyn\-based 501(c)(3\) nonprofit working to reduce overcrowded animal shelters in New York City and prevent more cats from ending up on the street in the first place. CPC is the nation’s largest Asian American social services organization and serves as a trusted community anchor to over 80,000 community members who are served by CPC annually through 50\+ high\-quality programs and services across 35 sites in New York City. (For more information, please visit: https://www.cpc\-nyc.org ).  



**JOB SUMMARY**

The Development Coordinator provides essential operational and fundraising support to CPC’s Development team. Under the supervision of the Donor Database Manager, the Coordinator assists with the day\-to\-day execution of established systems, workflows, and administrative processes, including gift and pledge processing, donor acknowledgements, Salesforce data maintenance, reconciliation, reporting, and department coordination. Working closely with the Donor Database Manager and other Development team members, the Coordinator helps ensure accurate records, timely donor recognition, and efficient fundraising operations.  



**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Donor Engagement**

* Draft acknowledgment of letters and tax receipts for all gifts in accordance with established gift processing procedures to ensure timely, accurate, and meaningful donor recognition.
* Conduct prospect and donor research as needed to support fundraising efforts and maintain accurate donor information.

**Data Management:**

* Support the Donor Database Manager with Salesforce data entry and data hygiene, including donor information, donor relationships, pledges, donations, workplace giving, and matching gifts across multiple platforms.
* Assist with reconciling gift records with the Finance team monthly and annually.
* Assist with preparing reports for internal and external stakeholders to track fundraising progress and evaluate fundraising efforts.

**Development Operations:**

* Contribute to the creation and implementation of the fundraising plan; conduct periodic check\-ins and assessments throughout the year.
* Prepare check requests, credit card expense reports, and invoices.
* Schedule meetings, maintain calendar, organize notes and documentation, and send reminders for the team.

**Other:**

* Provide administrative and logistical support for major fundraising events.
* Support Development team initiatives and perform special projects and other duties as assigned.

  
Qualifications
  
**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education and Experience:**

* Associate degree or higher and at least 2 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in nonprofit fundraising, development operations, database administration, or a related field.
* Relevant or transferable experience in required responsibilities; familiarity with the AAPI, immigrant, and low\-income communities.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Proficient in Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite; technologically proficient and quick to learn new systems. Experience with Concur, PaperSave, Robin, Canva, or similar systems preferred.
* Exhibit a high level of discretion, professionalism, and an ethical approach to fundraising.
* Ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities with limited supervision while collaborating effectively as part of a team.
* Exceptional attention to detail, critical thinking, organizational skills, project management skills, and commitment to data accuracy.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, dependable, and solutions\-oriented, with the judgment to troubleshoot routine issues and escalate when appropriate.
* Flexibility in varied job assignments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and reliability.
* Willing to contribute across Development team priorities as needed.

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS OVERVIEW**

* $30\.00 \- $36\.00 per hour; 35 hours per week with occasional evenings and weekends
CPC offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including but not limited to generous paid time off (holiday, sick and vacation time), Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life Insurance Coverage, Commuter Benefits, and a 403(b) Retirement Plan

All documents should be submitted as one single file. Applicants may reach out to careers@cpc\-nyc.org with any questions or further inquiries.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
At New York's Little Elves, excellence is our reputation. For over 30 years, we've set the platinum standard in fine interior cleaning, trusted by discerning clients, top designers, and architects, and recognized by New York Magazine and Curbed as Best Cleaning Company in New York.

We are seeking an Operations Coordinator to become part of our exceptional team. The Operations Coordinator is the first point of contact for our clients and a central support to our office team. This is a growth position. As we prepare for disciplined expansion over the next 3\-5 years, the person in this role will start by owning our client communications and booking support, and grow into broader operational responsibility as our systems and volume expand.

**About Us**

We specialize in high\-detail housekeeping and post\-construction cleaning for interior designers, architects, and luxury property managers throughout New York City. Our reputation is built on discretion, reliability, and meticulous attention to detail.

We are a small, tenured and welcoming team with over 40 employees on the field. We are a large family, with a strong community \- family culture. We have very little turnover and seek employees with similar priorities.

**Position Overview**

The Operations Coordinator is the front door to New York's Little Elves. This position owns how the office operates day to day, including: first\-line phone coverage, client email correspondence, website inquiries that bring in new work, and supports the booking process that turns those inquiries into scheduled jobs.

This is not a receptionist role. Phones and inbox are where the job begins, not where it ends. The right person will learn how the whole operation runs, take on projects that improve it, and grow with a company that is actively expanding. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail oriented and productive under pressure. Successful candidates thrive in a fast\-pasted environment where priorities shift quickly, are comfortable being friendly and can remain professional under pressure.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Client Communication*

● Answer incoming phone calls as the first point of contact

● Respond to client email correspondence with the care and detail our clients expect

● Manage inquiries submitted through our website

● Document client requests, reschedules, and job changes

*Booking Support*

● Support the booking process from first inquiry through confirmed job

● Gather and verify the details required to quote and schedule work accurately

● Follow up on outstanding inquiries so no request goes unanswered

*Operational Support*

● Work in our scheduling system daily and become the team's most fluent user of it

● Support the supply and inventory function alongside our operations team

● Maintain accurate client records across our systems

*Growth and Improvement*

● Take on defined projects that improve how the office runs

● Identify friction in day\-to\-day processes and bring solutions forward

● Note: Payroll, crew scheduling, and crew assignment remain with our General Manager and President. This role supports the operation; it does not run it.\*

**Qualifications**

● Experience in an administrative, coordination, client service, or office operations role

● Writes clearly and warmly. Our clients receive detailed, personal responses, and this person becomes the voice behind them

● Stays organized through constant interruption. Phones ring, emails arrive, and priorities shift within the same hour

● Curious about the whole operation rather than only their own corner of it

● Comfortable learning new software. This seat will live in a new scheduling platform every day

● Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred

● Previous work in building trades or luxury services helpful

**What We Offer**

● Salary $50,000 \+ Performance Bonus

● Comprehensive benefits, including a matching 401K retirement plan

● A clear path to greater responsibility as the company grows

● The opportunity to work with one of New York City's most respected cleaning companies

● A collaborative, tenured team with very little turnover

**Our Values**

Every person here is measured against the same five standards:

Excellence Without Compromise – Accountability at Every Level – Care for Our People, Care for Our Clients – White\-Glove Client Care – Operational Discipline Drives Growth

This company will grow based on our effort and team support.

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
