jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast\-growing, and high\-performing network of public charter schools takes a village \- families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole\-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

**About the Role**



The Corporate Talent Acquisition Operations Associate owns the administrative infrastructure, data auditing, and tracking systems that keep corporate recruiting running smoothly. This role audits requisitions and candidate data for accuracy, builds and maintains the trackers and tools recruiters and leadership rely on daily, and keeps the ATS clean and current across every open corporate role. It is a hands\-on operations, data, and tools\-building role: the recruiter owns relationships and candidate decisions, the coordinator owns scheduling and logistics, and this role owns ensuring the underlying data, trackers, and processes are accurate, up to date, and built to scale.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Conduct recurring audits of open requisitions and candidate records to catch stale stages, missing data, or SLA gaps, and flag them to the relevant recruiter or TA Manager.
* Build, update, and maintain trackers and dashboards covering pipeline health, req status, SLA compliance, and time\-to\-fill against target OKRs.
* Design and roll out administrative tools and templates (intake forms, tracker templates, comp/leveling checklists) that reduce manual work for recruiters and coordinators.
* Maintain ATS hygiene across all corporate requisitions by correcting statuses and stages and promptly closing out filled or canceled reqs.
* Monitor SLA adherence (scorecard turnaround, onsite\-scheduling windows, offer timelines) and route breaches per the team's escalation framework.
* Prepare recurring reporting packages and ad hoc data pulls for TA leadership, People/HR partners, and compliance requests.
* Document and continuously improve standard operating procedures for recurring TA processes.
* Partner with Recruiters and the Recruiting Coordinator to identify friction points and build the tool or tracker that solves them.
* Support internal audit requests by pulling clean, accurate data on demand.

**Qualifications**


* 2 to 4 years in talent acquisition operations, recruiting coordination, HR operations, or a similar data\- and process\-oriented role.
* Experience supporting multiple stakeholders across a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, with experience building and maintaining trackers, dashboards, or reports from scratch.
* Familiarity with an ATS or recruiting tech stack (Greenhouse, GEM, or similar) and comfort auditing data for accuracy.
* Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Competencies**


* Meticulous \& Detail\-Oriented: Catches data errors and process gaps that others miss.
* Systems\-Minded: Defaults to building a tracker or template rather than solving the same problem manually twice.
* Organized \& Reliable: Keeps multiple trackers, audits, and requests moving without anything slipping.
* Adaptable: Comfortable taking a messy, manual process and turning it into a clean, repeatable tool.
* Proactive: Flags risks and gaps before they become escalations.

**Compensation, Benefits \& Perks**



At Success Academy, we invest boldly in our Network team with a comprehensive package designed to support your health, financial future, and overall well\-being:


* Day\-One Health \& Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting your first day (SA covers 82% of our core medical plan), plus a free One Medical membership and confidential mental health support via EAP/Talkspace.

* Time to Recharge: Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave.

jobs.description:
**Front Desk \& Administrative Coordinator**

**20–40 Hours per Week \| Upper East Side, Manhattan**

We are seeking an **energetic, socially engaging and proactive Front Desk \& Administrative Coordinator** to support two partner companies, **Active Studios and Self Empowered Minds**, located just around the corner from one another on Manhattan’s Upper East Side.

This is much more than sitting behind a front desk. We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys people, brings positive energy into a space, takes initiative, works well as part of a team, and is comfortable helping promote our classes, services, workshops and trainings.

You’ll move between our two nearby locations as needed, helping create a welcoming experience while supporting the administrative, promotional and day\-to\-day needs of both businesses.

What You’ll Do

**Front Desk \& Client/Student Experience**

* Warmly greet students and clients and make them feel welcome
* Check students into classes and maintain accurate attendance
* Answer calls, emails and inquiries
* Assist with scheduling, registrations and appointments
* Maintain welcoming, organized and beautifully presented spaces
* Assist with light cleaning and resetting the spaces as needed
* Help with workshops, trainings and special events

**Administrative Support**

* Handle day\-to\-day administrative tasks
* Maintain organized student/client and scheduling information
* Learn and work with our scheduling and business systems
* Help ensure daily operations run smoothly
* Work collaboratively with instructors, practitioners and other team members

**Promotion, Outreach \& Social Media**

* Follow up with people who have expressed interest in our classes, services, workshops and trainings
* Help turn inquiries into registrations and appointments through warm, personable follow\-up
* Engage with students and clients and make them aware of other services, classes and events they may enjoy
* Actively help promote upcoming programs, workshops and special events
* Create and post social media content
* Take simple photos and videos when appropriate
* Create basic graphics and promotional content; Canva experience is a plus
* Help keep our social media presence active, current and engaging

Who We’re Looking For

We’re especially interested in someone who is:

* **Extremely punctual and dependable** — our students, clients and team rely on the front desk being ready on time
* **Energetic and socially engaging** — someone who genuinely enjoys talking with and getting to know people
* **Proactive** — someone who sees what needs to be done and takes initiative
* **A team player** — willing to jump in and help wherever needed
* Warm, personable and naturally welcoming
* Comfortable promoting services and making recommendations without being pushy
* Organized and able to manage multiple responsibilities
* Professional and discreet
* **Comfortable working in a Mac/Apple environment, including Mac laptops, iPhones and iPads**
* Comfortable learning and working with scheduling systems and other technology
* Comfortable creating and posting social media content
* Able to work independently without needing constant direction
* Interested in wellness, fitness, movement and/or personal development

Schedule \& Position Structure

**20–40 hours per week**

The exact schedule will depend on availability and experience. Some evening and weekend availability is important because our classes, workshops and trainings take place throughout the week.

This position will initially be structured as a **1099 independent contractor position**, with the potential to transition to a W\-2 employee position in the future. As a 1099 independent contractor, you are responsible for your own tax withholding and tax obligations.

About the Position

This position supports **Active Studios and Self Empowered Minds, two partner companies located just around the corner from one another on the Upper East Side.**

The environment and responsibilities vary throughout the day. You might be greeting students arriving for a class, helping someone register for a workshop, following up with an inquiry, creating a social media post, preparing for an event, completing administrative work, or welcoming a private wellness client.

We are looking for someone who enjoys variety, likes interacting with people and wants to become an active part of a small, growing team.

To Apply

Please submit your résumé along with a brief introduction telling us:

* A little about yourself
* Your general availability
* Why this particular position interests you

Pay: $20\.00 \- $23\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week

The Center for Computational Neuroscience (CCN) is currently seeking a full\-time Administrative Coordinator to support the growing financial and administrative operations of the Center in a collaborative environment.

* Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly. You will also have strong analytical, relationship management, and organizational skills.
* You'll be solution\-focused, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions.

**Who We Are:**
  

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad\-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners \- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically\-acclaimed, industry\-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. * Assist with talent/partner approval for marketing materials across lines of business.

* Brainstorm and pitch creative marketing ideas, content, and promotional opportunities for review and approval by senior team members.
* Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with partners. Support routine communication and coordination of marketing efforts and escalate complex partner matters as appropriate.
* Assist with regular reporting and insights, collecting, organizing, and summarizing established metrics to highlight the impact of marketing activities.
* Help track the status of fulfillment for marketing contractual obligations for partners.
* Assist with the tracking \& reporting of performance metrics across marketing placements \& listening data.
* Stay current on industry trends across the sports landscape \- shifts in audio content, podcasting, etc.
* Complete assigned work within established priorities, timelines, and procedures, seeking guidance when requirements or priorities are unclear.

* Strong familiarity with SiriusXM's sports content and talent.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Excellent time management and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and multi\-task, and work under shifting deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; must be able to communicate clearly and credibly to colleagues across the organization.

* Both a proactive team player and independent worker.
* Flexible and maintains positive attitude when under pressure and deadlines.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
**It's more than a job**
------------------------


As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne\+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.


###### **‎**


**How you create impact**
-------------------------


The Operational Key Account Manager is responisble for establishing and maintaining customer relationships, clarifying and formalizing operational requirements, and increasing customer satisfaction through tailored solutions. Internally, it includes acting as a liaison for customer needs, supporting compliance and RFQ processes, and managing customer information and rate cards. Additionally, the role focuses on KPI management, continuous improvement, and facilitating business reviews and ad hoc projects.

  

* Build and maintain strong customer relationships, serving as a main point of contact and escalation resource.
* Understand, negotiate, and formalize customer operational requirements while ensuring service excellence and tailored solutions.
* Identify and drive cost‑saving and continuous improvement initiatives across customer accounts.
* Support new business onboarding, serving as a subject matter expert and coordinating implementation processes.
* Partner with internal teams to facilitate corrective actions, resolve issues, and maintain operational and SOP compliance.
* Execute customer reporting, KPI tracking, and analytical functions for export, import, and regulatory needs.
* Prepare and present materials for business reviews, including KPI results, root‑cause analysis, and performance improvements.
* Maintain accurate customer data in KN systems, support EDI setup, and validate rate cards.
* Monitor internal compliance (billing, visibility, processes) and address gaps proactively.
* Support RFQ processes through data analysis, rate setup, and implementation of new business awarded.
**What we would like you to bring**
-----------------------------------


* Minimum of 2\+ years of operational experience in freight forwarding; commercial knowledge is a strong plus
* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Management, or a related field
* Demonstrated ability to influence, lead, and collaborate with internal teams while building strong, trust‑based relationships
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the confidence to drive internal and external process‑improvement initiatives
* Deep understanding of import and export freight forwarding operations, including systems, workflows, documentation, and security requirements
* Ability to ensure customer compliance through clear communication of international trade regulations
* Experience working within multi‑national and multi‑business‑unit environments
* Strong customer relationship management skills with proven success in client communication
* Experience in onboarding new business and executing effective implementation best practices
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
  

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.


**What's in it for you**
------------------------


At Kuehne\+Nagel we strive daily to inspire, empower, and deliver not only to our customers, but also to our colleagues. We offer a dynamic global work environment with opportunities for excellent training programs and career mobility. The target base salary range for this position is between $100,000 \- $105,000\. Base salary is part of a competitive total rewards package that includes health and welfare benefits, a 401k retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, and incentive compensation for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, skills, job location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. Kuehne\+Nagel reviews pay ranges regularly to ensure competitive and fair pay based on industry market data. \#LI\- TD1

  

Kuehne\+Nagel participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Employers can only use E\-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I\-9\.

**Who we are**
--------------


Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.


As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
***Key Responsibilities***

  

ISI Markets is looking for an experienced Sell\-Side Account Manager to manage, retain and grow a portfolio of institutional clients across the global financial markets.  



  

This is a commercially focused role with significant opportunity to expand existing relationships and drive adoption of ISI’s market\-leading fund flow intelligence, macroeconomic data, research and analytics.  



  

***What you’ll do***

  

* Own a portfolio of sell\-side client relationships, acting as the primary commercial contact.
* Build trusted relationships across research, strategy, economics, sales \& trading, capital markets, quantitative research and data teams.
* Drive renewals, retention, upsell and cross\-sell, identifying whitespace across clients, geographies and use cases.
* Leverage ISI’s established sell\-side relationships to uncover new revenue opportunities and expand adoption across the wider organisation.
* Partner with Product Sales Specialists and internal teams to develop account strategies and deliver growth.
* Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients identify new applications for ISI’s data across research, market intelligence, client engagement and capital markets workflows.
* Proactively manage renewal risk, commercial negotiations and account forecasting.
Represent the voice of the client internally, sharing market feedback and opportunities with Product and GTM teams.  
* 

  

***Experience \& Skills***

  

* Proven experience in sell\-side account management, client success or relationship management, ideally within financial data, SaaS, research or B2B information services.
* Strong understanding of how investment banks, broker\-dealers or research providers use data and analytics.
* Demonstrated success growing relationships and identifying cross\-sell and expansion opportunities within complex financial institutions.
* Credibility engaging with senior stakeholders including analysts, strategists, economists, quants and sales leaders.
* Strong commercial mindset with a track record of delivering retention and revenue growth.
* Excellent communication, presentation and relationship\-building skills.
* Genuine interest in financial markets, investor behaviour, fund flows, capital allocation and macroeconomic trends.
* Experience with Salesforce and other CRM/reporting tools.
* Understanding of APIs, data feeds and cloud delivery models is advantageous.
* Additional languages are desirable.
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in economics, finance, business, mathematics or a related discipline preferred.  
* 

***About ISI Markets Group***

ISI Markets Group is a leading provider of data, research and intelligence focused on the world's fastest\-growing and highest\-potential markets. We provide the intelligence and tools that inform confident strategic, investment and risk decisions for our clients worldwide.  



  

For more information visit **isimarkets.com**

***Working for Us***

ISI Markets is an ambitious and growing group, headquartered in London, with over 750 experts across a network of 20 offices worldwide, serving customers in 70 countries. We ensure that our culture enables our people to have a meaningful and rewarding career chapter with us:  



* **Stronger Together:** You will be part of a collaborative dynamic global sales team of 150 professionals.
* **Rewarding High Performance:** We offer competitive reward and commission structures as well as quarterly sales awards for our highest performers.
* **Inclusive Environment:** We believe our diversity is what helps us to win with over 40 nationalities represented amongst our global team.
* **Innovation:** We value fresh perspectives and expect our people to contribute and share their views.
* **Career Growth Opportunities:** We invest in our people through ongoing training and have a strong track record of promotion from within.
* **Hybrid Working:** We promote hybrid working in all of our offices and trust our employees to do their best work irrespective of where they are working.

  

***Equal Opportunity***

  

ISI Markets is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Account Manager plays a critical role in owning and advancing B2B relationships within the largest and most complex healthcare delivery networks, including health systems (HSs), Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), state CDC awardees, major health departments, and other large institutional accounts. Serving as the primary customer liaison, this role engages HCPs, senior\-level clinical and non\-clinical stakeholders to understand customer priorities, address unmet needs, and deliver customized, data\-driven value propositions.


The Account Manager is responsible for meeting or exceeding sales goals within an assigned territory by developing and executing a comprehensive territory and key account business plan aligned to brand strategy. This position requires the ability to confidently deliver approved scientific and clinical information to healthcare professionals, drive appropriate product utilization within approved indications, and effectively leverage organizational resources to optimize customer engagement.


Success is measured by strong account launch performance, consistent achievement of sales objectives, and sustained customer partnership development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer \& Account Management**

* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with large, organized customers, including IDNs, academic medical centers, and key decision\-makers (e.g., CMOs, Pharmacy Directors, Infectious Disease Specialists, and P\&T Committee members).
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, aligning customer needs with GSK’s brand strategy and value proposition.
* Identify and engage key clinical and non\-clinical influencers within healthcare delivery networks to ensure optimal account penetration and access.
* Discover and develop other stakeholders within key clinics and accounts.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, Media Enablement Team
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you excited about improving the advertiser experience on one of the world's largest programmatic advertising platforms? As a Technical Account Manager on the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP) team, you will focus on improving how advertisers run Deals by identifying patterns in supply\-related issues, decreasing time to resolution, and equipping advertisers and account managers with the knowledge they need to succeed. You will work across Client Account Management, SSP Partnership, and Product and Engineering teams to balance quick fixes with long\-term supply improvements.  

You will surface patterns in support tickets that point to larger opportunities — whether that means strengthening the supply network, improving products, or helping clients and partners get more from the platform. This role calls for strong analytical ability and a solution\-oriented mindset, because the team designs solutions to prevent problems proactively rather than simply reacting to ticket volume. You should be familiar with industry trends including supply path optimization and emerging formats such as Audio, Digital Out of Home (DOOH), and live events, and comfortable communicating supply\-side capabilities to senior business and technical leaders inside and outside Amazon.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Understand advertiser goals, facilitate their usage of Deals on the DSP platform, and proactively identify optimization opportunities by working with Account Teams, Product, Engineering, and SSP partners.
* Analyze support ticket patterns and key performance trends across clients, then translate findings into data\-driven recommendations that reduce time to resolution and improve the overall advertiser experience.
* Investigate and root\-cause supply issues in partnership with Solution Architects, Product Managers, and Engineering, ensuring timely resolution while capturing insights that inform longer\-term product and process improvements.
* Provide training and operational support to internal Client Account teams, advertisers, and SSP or Publisher partners, equipping them with the knowledge to resolve common issues independently.
* Contribute to scalable playbooks and best practices that raise troubleshooting quality across the team, and share account management expertise with peers.

  

A day in the life  

You start by reviewing your troubleshooting ticket queue, root\-causing supply issues for your advertisers and prioritizing by business impact. By midday, you are partnering with engineering and product teams on a process improvement that will flag delivery issues before a ticket is even created. In the afternoon, you compile patterns from recent cases into a recommendation for leadership, then update a playbook so the broader team can apply what you learned. As you grow in the role, you spend more time designing high\-scale solutions with engineering and partners and less time in the ticket queue.  

  

About the team  

Amazon Ads helps advertisers find and connect with customers through a broad set of digital advertising solutions. Amazon DSP is Amazon's programmatic advertising product for campaigns spanning Video, Audio, and Display across Amazon properties (for example, Amazon.com, Freevee, Twitch, Fire TV, and Amazon Music) and tens of thousands of third\-party websites and apps. Our team is focused on improving the advertiser experience on the DSP platform, and we are investing in scalable tools and processes that strengthen our supply network for the long term. If you want to grow into a Solution Architect role and enjoy solving problems that sit at the intersection of advertising, technology, and client partnership, we would love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience in e\-commerce or online advertising
* Experience in optimizing products and services based on client needs

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* • Experience building agentic tools to reduce operational workload.

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Location: Manhattan, NY, United States  

Date Updated: Sep 4, 2026  

Job ID: 18082


  
**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

* Provide actionable field insights regarding market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer feedback.

**Compliance \& Operational Excellence**

jobs.title: Employee Experience & Talent Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Vega**
--------------


The $250B insurance claims industry runs on fax machines, phone tag, and adjusters buried in paperwork. Cycle times stretch for months. Data is locked in legacy systems. And the workforce is aging out faster than it's being replaced.


Vega is the premier AI\-native claims TPA built to replace that entire stack. Our team is equal parts experienced insurance operators and modern technologists. We care deeply about delivering superior outcomes for our clients, and we want builders that get their hands dirty shipping solutions that move the needle.


Our results: 10x YoY revenue growth, and on track for $XXM run\-rate in under 2 years. Backed by marquee VCs like General Catalyst and Valor.

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for an Employee Experience \& Talent Coordinator to help us hire great people and make our office a place people genuinely love coming to. You'll sit on the People team, splitting your time between recruiting coordination and employee experience — scheduling interviews and running a great onsite candidate experience, keeping our office and employee events running smoothly, and supporting new hires as they onboard.


This is a highly in\-person role: you'll be in our New York office four days a week, and you'll be the person who makes the day\-to\-day experience — for candidates, new hires, and the team — feel organized, warm, and well run.


You'll do well here if you like variety, don't mind switching gears a few times a day, and take real pride in the small things that make an office, hiring \& people processes, feel well run. Bonus points if you're already using AI in your day\-to\-day and are eager to find smarter, more efficient ways to run our tools and workflows.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**In\-Office Experience \& Employee Events**

* Own the day\-to\-day office experience — keeping the space tidy, stocked, organized, and welcoming
* Manage vendor relationships (cleaning, maintenance, food \& beverage, security) and hold them to a high standard
* Plan and run in\-office events, team lunches, happy hours, and other employee experience moments
* Coordinate logistics for visitors, onsite candidates, and company gatherings
* Manage office access including badge distribution
* Host guests, candidates, and visitors so every visit reflects well on the company
* Support space planning, furniture moves, and office improvement projects

**Recruiting Coordination**

* Schedule and coordinate interviews across multiple open roles, keeping candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers aligned
* Own the onsite candidate experience — greeting candidates, running interview days smoothly, and making sure every visit feels polished
* Communicate with candidates throughout the process so they always know what's next
* Use Ashby ATS's scheduling tools to automate where you can and keep manual work to a minimum
* Keep our applicant tracking system accurate and up to date with candidate stages and notes

**People Operations**

* Support new hire onboarding so first days are smooth and welcoming (paperwork, system access, first\-day setup, etc.)
* Help prepare onboarding materials, schedules, and workspace setup
* Field People\-related questions on onboarding, HR data, benefits, and employment verifications
* Process employee changes in HiBob and partner with IT and Payroll to keep new hire information accurate
* Maintain and update People team documentation as processes change
* Pitch in on People team projects as they come up

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 1–3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, office management, or a related operational role
* Strong organizational skills — you can juggle multiple schedules and priorities without dropping details
* A warm, people\-first approach — you make candidates and employees feel welcome
* Experience with Recruiting ATS platforms, calendar tools and HRIS systems a plus (Ashby or HiBob for example)
* Resourcefulness — you figure things out and take initiative rather than waiting to be told
* Startup or fast\-paced environment experience
* Excitement to be in office four days a week and help build the culture in person

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive Salary
* Equity \- giving you direct stake in the future of an AI\-native industry leader.
* Top\-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401k with company match.
* Flexible PTO and a work from home stipend.
* A fast\-paced, high\-talent density team that values transparency and shipping fast.

*We set our salary ranges using compensation data from companies similar to our stage and size. For this role, the estimated salary range for this position is $70,000 \- $90,000\. The actual salary will vary depending on multiple factors unique to each candidate, including location, job\-related knowledge, transferable skills, work experience and our assessment of your level during the interview process. Vega offers equity for all full\-time employees, which is not included in the range listed above and will have an impact on your overall compensation.*

*Vega is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We'd like to consider you for this position and roles that may be a fit in the future.*

*Vega is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Vega considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the New York Fair Chance Ordinance.*


Compensation Range: $70K \- $90K

jobs.description:
**Site Development Project Coordinator**

*Location: Downtown Decatur, GA (On\-site, MARTA Accessible) \| Reports To: Project Manager \| Schedule: Full\-Time, Mon\-Fri (8:30 AM – 5:30 PM)*

**About Contineo Group**

Welcome to Contineo Group! If you are looking for a workplace that feels like a true community, you've found it. We foster a culture built on trust, flexibility, and the courage to think for ourselves. Our compass guides everything we do: **Show Up, Connect. Deliver.** We believe in lifting you up, clearing the path forward, and providing a supportive space for you to grow into your full potential. Around here, people always come first, and we take real pride in doing honest work we can stand behind.

**About the Role**

Not all Project Coordinator roles are created equal—and we are looking for someone with a very specific skillset. We are seeking a highly organized Site Development Project Coordinator who understands the unique landscape of civil engineering, land development, and commercial construction. In this role, you will be the organizational backbone of our Project Management team, ensuring the seamless execution of developer\-driven site development projects across retail, industrial, restaurants, multifamily, and golf course sectors.

If you know how to navigate municipal permitting, love diving into due diligence research for potential development sites, and can expertly juggle subconsultant coordination, you are exactly who we are looking for. You will bring order and precision to internal workflows, track critical tasks from project setup through closeout, and ensure our engineers have the support they need to deliver craftsmanship.

**A Quick Note Before You Apply:** To be successful in this role, you must have prior experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) or land development industry. We love general project managers, but for this specific seat, we need someone who understands site development lifecycles, due diligence, and permitting!

**What You'll Do (The Day\-to\-Day)**

· Due Diligence \& Research: Act as a research analyst by gathering critical project data, zoning codes, and jurisdictional requirements to help developers and Project Managers assess site viability and scope projects accurately.

· Master the Permitting Process: Navigate the complexities of local jurisdictions. Monitor permitting and submission schedules, coordinate document deliveries/retrievals, and keep projects moving through the approval gauntlet.

· Subconsultant Coordination: Manage the moving parts by coordinating with external partners (surveyors, geotechnical engineers, environmental consultants, traffic experts). Ensure subconsultant agreements are completed, named, and stored properly.

· Project Tracking \& Scheduling: Own the project logistics. Use Smartsheet and other tracking tools to monitor deadlines, milestones, and project progress. Assist with scheduling meetings, preparing agendas, and compiling follow\-up action items.

· Document Management: Create initial project folders, maintain proposal content archives, and ensure all contract documents and internal forms are organized. Assist in organizing final deliverables and project closeout documentation.

· Cross\-Functional Support: Review and provide guidance on client invoices, track proposal statuses, and assist in compiling documentation for case studies or marketing use.

**What You Bring to the Table**

**Your Experience \& Technical Toolbox:**

· 2–4 years of project coordination experience specifically within Civil Engineering, Architecture, Land Development, or Commercial Construction (Required).

· Proven experience assisting with site due diligence, permitting processes, and subconsultant coordination.

· Strong working knowledge of digital collaboration platforms (Smartsheet and Google Workspace are heavily utilized here).

· Exceptional file organization, version control habits, and task\-level proficiency in document management tools.

**Your Mindset:**

· You are a master of organization and genuinely detail\-oriented—nothing slips through the cracks on your watch.

· You are a clear, prompt communicator with a team\-oriented support mindset.

· You thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility to handle varied tasks while under the direction of Project Managers.

· You are self\-accountable, proactive, and take immense pride in supporting a team that delivers high\-quality work.

**Why Choose Contineo?**

We promise to show up for you by investing in your growth and well\-being. In return, we ask that you show up for our clients and our team with precision and intent. Here’s how we support your health, financial security, and personal well\-being:

· Health \& Wellness: Medical, Dental, \& Vision insurance, Mental Health Resources, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Long\-Term Disability, and Lactation Accommodation.

· Growth \& Family: Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Holidays, Paid Parental \& Maternity Leave, Tuition Reimbursement, real Mentorship \& Coaching, and a Robust Online LMS.

· Financial \& Civic: Competitive Salary, 401(k) Matching, Workers' Compensation, Jury Duty \& Voting Leave, and Military \& Personal Leave.

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Coordinator--Start-Up & Commissioning
jobs.description:
Description:  



**Position Purpose**
====================


The Start\-Up \& Commissioning Project Coordinator is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, documentation, and field execution required to start, test, verify, and turn over HVAC and mechanical systems on assigned projects. Success in this role requires anticipating commissioning needs, coordinating technicians and trade partners, resolving deficiencies, maintaining accurate documentation, and ensuring systems are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements.


This position works closely with Project Managers, Project Executives, field leadership, controls, service/start\-up technicians, subcontractors, vendors, commissioning agents, engineers, and customers to remove obstacles and drive projects from construction completion through functional testing, owner acceptance, and turnover.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Develop and maintain a clear start\-up and commissioning plan that aligns with the project schedule and turnover milestones.
* Keep start\-up technicians, vendors, controls, and field teams coordinated so equipment and systems are ready when needed.
* Identify, track, and drive resolution of deficiencies that could delay testing, commissioning, or owner acceptance.
* Maintain complete, accurate start\-up, testing, commissioning, and turnover documentation.
* Build strong working relationships with project teams, commissioning agents, engineers, vendors, and customers while protecting Maxair’s interests.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Operational Leadership**
--------------------------

* Plan and coordinate equipment start\-up, pre\-functional checks, functional performance testing, and commissioning activities for assigned projects.
* Develop look\-ahead schedules and manpower plans for start\-up and commissioning activities in coordination with the project schedule.
* Confirm systems are ready for start\-up by coordinating completion of installation, power, controls, piping, ductwork, TAB prerequisites, and manufacturer requirements.
* Coordinate factory\-authorized representatives, vendors, subcontractors, controls providers, TAB contractors, and internal technicians.
* Track equipment status, deficiencies, punch\-list items, retesting, and completion dates; escalate issues before they affect milestones.
* Review plans, specifications, submittals, sequences of operation, and commissioning requirements to understand testing and turnover obligations.
* Maintain start\-up reports, checklists, commissioning forms, test records, deficiency logs, and project completion documentation.

**People Leadership**
---------------------

* Set clear daily and weekly priorities for start\-up and commissioning personnel and provide timely direction and feedback.
* Promote safe work practices, quality workmanship, accountability, and professional communication during testing and turnover activities.
* Support the development of technicians and field leaders by sharing system knowledge, lessons learned, and commissioning best practices.

**Customer \& Business Leadership**
-----------------------------------

* Communicate proactively with Project Managers, customers, commissioning agents, engineers, and field leaders regarding status, risks, deficiencies, and upcoming testing needs.
* Represent Maxair professionally during commissioning meetings, inspections, functional testing, and owner demonstrations.
* Coordinate warranty/start\-up issues and ensure open items are assigned, documented, and driven to closure.
* Support project closeout by helping ensure required training, O\&M information, test documentation, and commissioning records are complete.
* Make timely decisions that protect schedule, quality, customer relationships, and project profitability.

  

Requirements:
**Qualifications**
==================

* Strong commercial HVAC/mechanical systems experience, including equipment start\-up, controls, and system operation.
* Working knowledge of HVAC equipment, hydronic systems, air systems, controls sequences, and commissioning processes.
* Ability to read construction drawings, specifications, submittals, control diagrams, and sequences of operation.
* Strong planning, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple trades, vendors, technicians, and project stakeholders under changing field conditions.
* OSHA 30 Certification and valid driver’s license required based on company standards.
* Proficiency with Excel, Word, Outlook, project management/job cost software, and electronic commissioning documentation.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================


Successful Start\-Up \& Commissioning Project Coordinators consistently plan ahead, communicate clearly, hold themselves and others accountable, collaborate across departments and trades, make sound decisions under changing conditions, and build trust through reliable follow\-through. They take ownership of system readiness and turnover, surface problems early, and drive issues to closure while reflecting Maxair’s Core Values every day.

**U.S. Soccer Overview**


The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good.


We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S.

  

U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitious plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision\-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results.

**Soccer Forward Overview**


Soccer Forward is U.S. Soccer’s social impact and legacy initiative, created to harness the power of soccer to improve lives and strengthen communities across the country. Launched in the lead\-up to the 2026 FIFA Men’s World Cup, Soccer Forward is focused on ensuring the impact of this moment extends well beyond the tournament by creating greater access and opportunity to experience, play and participate in the game.


Through programs, partnerships and community\-based activations, Soccer Forward brings together organizations from across the soccer ecosystem, U.S. Soccer partners and donors, and national and local community organizations to create meaningful and lasting impact. By connecting U.S. Soccer’s reach and resources with organizations already doing important work in communities, Soccer Forward helps expand access to the game, strengthen the people and places that make soccer possible, and use the sport as a vehicle for positive change.


The Soccer Forward team develops and delivers thoughtful social impact strategies, programs and events that bring Soccer Forward’s priorities to life in communities across the country. Through community\-based activations, key U.S. Soccer moments and partner\-supported events, the team creates meaningful opportunities to expand access to the game, increase participation and strengthen communities. The team works closely with U.S. Soccer’s sponsors, media partners and donors to integrate their priorities into this work in authentic and impactful ways, while building and managing relationships with community organizations, U.S. Soccer members and other key stakeholders across the soccer ecosystem.

**Position Description**


The Research Coordinator will support the delivery of key research initiatives led by the Kang Women’s Institute, with a focus on improving female health, performance, and participation in soccer.


Working with researchers, industry partners, practitioners and governing bodies, this role will help ensure the successful execution of the Kang Women’s Institute’s research agenda. The Research Coordinator will help with the management of current research activities, support screening processes, and identify new research collaborations and partnerships.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Support the creation and ongoing management of a research consortium.
* Organize quarterly consortium meetings, other events and conferences, including scheduling, agenda development, meeting logistics and follow\-up actions events and conferences.
* Support with communication to consortium members including providing updates, meeting notes, and summary reports.
* Collaborate with the KWI team to coordinate and support research initiatives, ensuring deadlines are met, and clear communication is maintained.
* Support with the management and screening of inbound research requests using a prioritization process.
* Support with the identification of potential research partners including institutes, governing bodies, and industry.
* Facilitate collaboration between researchers, practitioners, governing bodies, and industry partners.
* Support with the screening of papers and projects to expand internal education knowledge base and work closely with the education team to provide insights to inform future education/curriculum development.
* Support with protocol design, IRB processes, participant recruitment, timelines and associated administration.
* Support the synthesis and communication of research findings through reports, presentations, and ecosystem\-facing content.
* Support the development of a centralized women's sport science data repository.
* Manage internal and external reporting processes to ensure key stakeholders are updated on research progress.


Requirements:
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Undergraduate degree in a relevant field (e.g. sports science, physiology, public health, or related discipline) or equivalent advanced research experience
* 2\+ years of experience in research, applied sport science, or related fields
* 2\+ years of experience managing research projects or partnerships across multiple stakeholders
* Demonstrable understanding of research design, data collection, and applied translation
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex findings into clear outputs
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and manage multiple workstreams simultaneously

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience working in female athlete health and performance
* Experience working in research environments
* A passion for advancing research that improves participation and performance in soccer
* A Master's degree in a relevant field

**About Us**
------------

  

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high\-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our strategic plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work\-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers.


**About Georgia Tech**
  

Georgia Tech is a top\-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top\-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1\.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.


**Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**
  

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:


1\. Students are our top priority.
  

2\. We strive for excellence.
  

3\. We thrive on diversity.
  

4\. We celebrate collaboration.
  

5\. We champion innovation.
  

6\. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.
  

7\. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.
  

8\. We act ethically.


9\. We are responsible stewards.


Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.


**About the School of Civil \& Environmental Engineering at the Georgia Institute of Technology**
  

The School of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Georgia Tech currently has over 650 undergraduate students, nearly 320 graduate students, 55 tenure\-track faculty members, and 4 Professors of the Practice. Women comprise 50% of the undergraduate population, and more than 29% of the undergraduate student population identifies as a member of under\-represented minority groups. Thirteen faculty members are women, and eight faculty members identify as a member of under\-represented minority groups. Twenty\-six faculty members hold endowed chairs or professorships with 30% of them being women faculty. The School's Strategic Vision is available at www.ce.gatech.edu/strategic\-vision. The corresponding graduate programs are ranked \#3 and \#4, respectively.


We are a vibrant and intellectually diverse School, with people who are using new technologies to expand the notion of what it means to be civil and environmental engineers in the 21st Century. We teach our students the engineering fundamentals needed to be successful at the interface of the built and the natural worlds. Our program focuses on learning how to think, how to solve problems, and how to impact society for the better. We provide rigorous learning environments, together with out\-of\-the\-classroom and overseas experiences challenging our students to reach their highest potential.

Purchasing Power is a leading employee purchase program that helps people buy the products and services they need through the convenience of payroll deduction. * Proactively identify and report potential risks associated with each client and broker
* Effectively identify and partner with brokers to execute any upsell opportunities
* Optimize client and broker experience across sales, client services, marketing, and customer experience
* Serve as account owner and decision maker on relationship affecting issues/escalations
* Develop strategic recommendation for continual improvement and expansion of client and broker relationships
* Document new processes/policies/procedures relating to the client and oversees training on these to applicable internal staff

**The Experience You Will Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business or related field or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5\+ years of Account management experience
* Experience with managing employee benefit offerings / programs
* Possess financial acumen, analytical and operations skills
* Experience using Microsoft Office products (Pivot tables, Power Point, etc)
* Experience using CRM tools (Salesforce)
* Able to travel as needed for client stewardships, benefit fairs, client/broker, and events
* Proven annual goal attainment

jobs.description:
At The Coca\-Cola Company, we exist to refresh the world and make a difference through loved brands, done sustainably for a better shared future. Working here is more than working for the global beverage leader; it’s an opportunity to be a part of something that can positively impact the world. Our North America Operating Unit (NAOU) Advanced Hydration division is a dynamic, fast‑paced business unit at The Coca‑Cola Company where teams come together to lead what’s next in hydration. With a portfolio that includes BODYARMOR Sports Drink, Powerade, **vitamin**water, and **smart**water, the group is driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, strong collaboration, and shared ambition. This is a place for people who think differently, move with agility, challenge the status quo, and thrive in an ever‑changing category. Joining the team means helping shape the future of hydration alongside passionate, collaborative teams committed to winning.

**THE ADVANCED HYDRATION DIVISION** is looking for a ***Key Account Manager, Albertsons*** to join our team.


The Key Account Manager, Albertsons, will lead a cross\-functional team delivering business results across our Albertsons business on the west coast. This individual will provide subject matter expertise to resolve complex customer issues and deliver annual goals.

Customer Development

* Drive processes and execution of annual plans across assigned customers and bottlers. Delivery of key business and financial metrics including topline results (Revenue, volume, Share) and key financial metrics (trade spend and T\&E budgets) will be required.
* Partner with Sr. Management and cross\-functional team members to build Annual Plans to achieve both short\-term and long\-term business objectives.
* Lead divisional annual negotiations ensuring an optimized partnership agreement is in place that supports overall organizational priorities.
* Collaborative leader of a cross functional team responsible for the development and implementation of overall customer selling stories, while providing key insights to deliver key execution metrics (Pricing, Merchandising, and Innovation).
* Oversee the on\-going account updates and performance reporting against key metrics and problem solves plan gaps while bringing forward recommendations to deliver on required business objectives.
* Develop and leverage top level external relationships to optimize brand positioning in the market.

* Participate in all system routines as needed (Customer Core Teams) to provide customer updates including annual plan targets and elements and on\-going customer performance updates and action plans to deliver annual plans.
* Work closely with Coca\-Cola NAOU \+ Bottler Customer Leads (Directors/AE’s) to maximize mutual customer plans, results, and execution.
* Build and leverage relationships with both internal teams and Bottlers to ensure alignment and focus on delivering key customer objectives.


Cross Functional Communication and Collaboration

* Provide on\-going updates on customer plan results and opportunities to Advanced Hydration management.
* Participate in key cross functional routines to provide on\-going plan updates and ensure flawless execution of customer programs and initiatives.
* Provide customer input to annual plans including all Marketing, Commercial and Innovation plans.


Organizational/People Development

* Fully leverage all cross functional resources to deliver best in class capabilities to customers including selling stories, consumer and customer marketing and insights and revenue growth management plans.
* Manage to an annual T\&E budget for department ensuring alignment with internal financial objectives.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or relevant experience required.
* 5 Years’ experience with National Account management experience building and executing JBPs with a customer required
* CPG National Account Management experience required
* Residence within the Phenix, AZ (within 50 miles) area required

jobs.description:
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data\-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.



Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare's greatest needs. Through our mission\-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.

**Work Location:** This position is designated as remote. However, employees who reside within a 40\-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).


**Position Summary**



We are seeking a highly skilled, proactive, and operationally minded Executive Assistant to support the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and provide executive support to the SVP, Head of Finance. This role will also serve as a key connector across the Finance organization and broader executive leadership team.



This role is designed for a strategic, detail\-oriented professional who will be responsible for creating order, driving operational excellence, and ensuring priorities remain aligned, timelines are met, and leaders stay on course. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, has exceptional communication and organizational skills, and is equally comfortable handling high\-level executive priorities and day\-to\-day administrative responsibilities.



The successful candidate will have a strong sense of ownership and the ability to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and proactively bring solutions. This individual must be comfortable operating with a high degree of independence and discretion while supporting two senior Finance leaders and navigating a dynamic, constantly changing environment.

* Coordinate effectively with other Executive Assistants and key stakeholders across the organization to ensure alignment and smooth execution.
* Maintain visibility into important commitments, deadlines, and follow\-up items to help keep both executives on track.

* Gather, organize, and synthesize information from multiple stakeholders to support executive priorities and decision\-making.
* Ensure executive communications and materials are clear, polished, timely, and appropriately tailored to the audience.

* Exercise sound judgment when determining priorities, resolving scheduling conflicts, and protecting executive time.
* Coordinate travel itineraries, accommodations, transportation, and detailed briefings to ensure smooth logistics.
* Plan and execute internal and external meetings, events, and executive engagements.
* Coordinate meeting logistics, including agendas, materials, participants, conference rooms, technology, and follow\-up.
* Ensure the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance are fully prepared for meetings by anticipating needs and coordinating necessary information and materials in advance.
* Adjust quickly to changing schedules and priorities while maintaining organization and professionalism.


**Administrative Excellence**


* Oversee traditional executive administrative activities, including expense reports, document management, contract routing, and other administrative processes.
* Serve as a point of contact for internal and external partners on behalf of the CFO and SVP, Head of Finance.

* Monitor and follow up on outstanding items to ensure timely completion.
* Continuously refine and improve administrative and operational processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
At NAVEX, we’re transforming the world—making it safer, more ethical, and ensuring every voice is heard. That’s real impact.
  
  

Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values. We move with speed, passion and purpose — as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right.
  
  

If you are a highly motivated and tenacious individual looking to grow your career in a business\-to\-business (B2B) sales environment, we have a great opportunity for you!
  
  

Our Business Development Representative (BDR) team plays a key role within our broader Sales organization bringing new business opportunities to life! As a BDR, you will be driving new business growth by identifying and creating opportunities in untapped markets through proactive and strategic outbound prospecting and building a strong pipeline that leads to successful deals closed. You’ll connect with diverse B2B prospects, develop deep expertise in the risk and compliance industry, and sharpen your skills to persist, overcome challenges, and deliver results.
  
  

This is a role for a competitive self\-starter who has a hunger to win, creates momentum, is resilient and stays relentlessly focused on achieving your goals. Accelerate your impact and unlock exciting opportunities to further your career growth in Sales with our team!
  
  

You’ll thrive in this hybrid role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to your success. Join us and help shape what’s next!
  
  

**What you’ll get:**  

* Meaningful Purpose. Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people—at a scale few companies can match.
* High\-Performance Environment. We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career.
* Candid, Supportive Culture. We communicate openly, challenge ideas—not people—and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement.
* Growth That Matters. You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth.
* Rewards for Results. We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact.


**What you’ll do:**  

* Compete to win and exceed your monthly quota by maintaining high call activity and quickly assessing a prospect’s “fit”
* Proactively generate qualified leads by cold calling, engaging with and developing prospects for the Sales team to close
* Document, track and monitor all leads and activities in Salesforce.com
* Utilize smart, targeted questions to speak knowledgeably with decision makers such as VPs, Directors and C\-suite personnel
* Acquire in depth knowledge of our full range of risk and compliance solutions and services, conveying that knowledge to potential customers, and adhering to company messaging and positioning
* Nurture relationships with longer term prospects
* Conduct territory development best practices with email, phone and chat using sales enablement tools to connect with new prospects and current customers


**What you’ll bring:**  

* Previous sales, telemarketing or lead generation experience; cloud computing or SaaS industry experience preferred
* A tenacious work ethic with a desire to have a career in sales
* Competitive drive, a hunger to win and a self\-starter mindset—you create opportunities, take ownership, and stay focused on results to meet and exceed quota monthly, maintain a high call rate and quickly assess prospect’s “fit”
* Grit and know\-how with a curious and creative mindset to set goals to achieve bigger outcomes
* Technical acumen to ramp up quickly on core technologies such as Salesforce, Groove, etc.
* A modest yet assertive and confident demeanor with empathy and compassion
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent communication skills, presentations skills with the ability to craft compelling narratives to engage and influence executive\-level decision makers
* Culture Agility. Comfort working in a fast\-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow\-through
* AI Readiness. Curiosity and willingness to use AI and emerging technologies to elevate your work and deliver smarter outcomes
* Fuel performance and outcomes. Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values


**Our side of the deal:**  

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* On\-Target Earnings of $70,000 per year. The starting pay for this role is $24\.04 per hour and the target variable pay for this role is $20,000\. Target variable pay is based on individual achievement factors and is not guaranteed. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. NAVEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to including individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities and veteran status.

**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. **About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

**OnPay is a fast\-growing software company headquartered in Atlanta, offering a modern cloud\-based payroll, HR, and benefits solution for small to midsize businesses. **The Role**


The **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** role serves as the entry point into a client\-facing sales career at OnPay, providing your initial experience in selling our product suite. Our SDR team plays a vital role in supporting our Account Executives by fielding inbound inquiries and generating new pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting by leveraging phone, email, and social outreach to identify, engage, and qualify net\-new small and midsize businesses beyond our inbound lead engine. Successful SDRs critically think and learn through coaching from their mentors, building upon and improving their skills throughout their tenure in this role.

jobs.description:
**About Atlanta United FC**


Atlanta United is Major League Soccer’s 22nd franchise and began play in 2017\. The club’s avid fan base has set MLS records in fan participation, including leading the MLS in number of season tickets sold for an expansion franchise and setting a new record for number of attendees at an MLS match. Atlanta United is owned by Arthur Blank, co\-founder of the Home Depot, and led by club President Darren Eales. Atlanta United is a member of AMB Sports \& Entertainment, which also includes the Atlanta Falcons and Mercedes\-Benz Stadium.

**About Atlanta United FC Academy**


Officially launched in 2016 prior to its first season in MLS, the Atlanta United Academy program aims to be the leading platform of youth soccer development in the Southeast and currently competes in the U.S. Soccer Development Academy program. The ATL UTD Academy consists of teams in age groups U\-12, U\-13, U\-14, U\-15, U\-16, U\-17 and U\-19\. Shared with the first team, the Academy trains and competes out of the Training Ground.

**About AMB Sports \+ Entertainment Group**


AMB Sports \& Entertainment Group is a subsidiary of AMB Group, LLC, and is comprised of the Atlanta Falcons Football Club, LLC, Atlanta’s Major League Soccer team, Atlanta United FC, and the new Mercedes\-Benz Stadium.


Position Summary


This position provides support and assistance in the areas of ticket resolution, order fulfillment and ticket distribution for Atlanta United and Atlanta United 2\.


Roles and Responsibilities

* Assist in the processing and establishment of season ticket, group and single match ticket accounts.
* Provide game\-day support in the area of ticket resolution, customer service, and other ticketing needs.
* Provide daily support to internal sales and customer service teams.
* Coordinate in\-house and on\-line ticket order fulfillment.
* Aid in other duties, functions, and tasks as assigned by full\-time associates of the department.
* Assist with Atlanta United 2 matches.


Qualifications and Education Requirements

* Ability to deliver excellent service to fans.
* Strong written and oral communication, prioritization, and organization skills.
* Proficient with MS Word and Excel.
* Ticketmaster Archtics experience a plus but not required.
* Ability to multi\-task, problem solve effectively and handle stressful and difficult situations.
* Must be able to work Monday through Friday and match days (during week or on weekends).

**Required Skills**

* Excellent oral communication skills.
* Excellent time management and organizational skills.
* Excellent problem solving/critical thinking skills.
* Ability to operate a variety of computer applications including but not limited to Microsoft’s suite of products such as Word, Excel and Outlook, Ticketmaster and customized in\-house ticketing system and database.
* Ability to work well in a team environment and autonomously.


The requirements for this position include, but are not limited to, those outlined above. All duties and requirements are essential job functions and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise. It is the employer’s discretion to add or change the duties or requirements of this position at any time.

If the answer is, "Yes!" then we have an opportunity that will excite you. Who are we? We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies.  



ARCO/Murray National Construction is currently looking for a detail\-oriented, self\-reliant Project Coordinator to join our team. At ARCO, you'll have the opportunity to improve project performance, set up processes and drive your own success from day one!  


**A Day in the Life:*** Typing/preparing various items such as letters, bid instructions, meeting minutes, weekly updates, memos, proposals, outline specifications, timesheets, and expense reports
* Assist Project Managers with Proposals by typing up proposal letters, outline specifications, manage the work/design schedule and assemble proposal books in a timely manner as per Project Manager

* Prepare various forms as directed by Projects Managers (Subcontracts, Purchase Orders, Change Orders, AGC Agreements, Professional Service Agreements, and transmittals)
