* Book all travel when necessary
* Answer incoming phone calls and coordinate communication with vendors and customers in the event of a Project Manager's absence
* Maintain all files, including preparing new files and sending old files off site

  


**Necessary Qualifications:*** 3\-10 years of related experience, construction administration experience considered a plus
* Excellent computer skills, must be proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel
* Must be extremely organized, self\-reliant, proactive, and detail\-oriented

  


**What We Can Offer You:**We are dedicated to the well\-being of our associates and are proud to be consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work. Our compensation and benefits package not only supports our associates and their families but benefits local communities and communities around the world.


* Industry\-leading performance\-based bonus program
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Traditional and Roth 401k
* Tuition reimbursement for associates
* Scholarship for associates' children up to $28,000 per child
* 1\-month paid sabbatical after every five years of employment, plus $5,000 for travel
* 1\-week paid volunteer leave each year
* 100% charitable match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* Paid parental leave


Typical base compensation for the Project Coordinator role is between $60,000 and $80,000\. Candidates with extensive experience may exceed this range. In addition to base salary, the role is eligible to receive discretionary bonus compensation based on individual and company.

We hire the best and the brightest from across the country – constructing a team of experts in architecture, design, engineering, project management, and business services.

Most importantly, our clients like us, trust us, and want to do business with us. We are looking for people with the same enthusiasm, passion, and respect for the hard work that brought us to where we are today. Are you a person who can make a difference at ARCO? If the answer is "Yes!" we look forward to meeting you.

### **Office of Workforce Development**


**School of Social Work**

Work closely with the PRIDE Program Administrator to support program goals, ensure high\-quality service delivery, and maintain the effectiveness and integrity of the PRIDE program. Manage assigned projects to ensure timely completion, providing regular updates to the program administrator. Supervise a team of trainers and support staff, ensure effective workflow and provide coaching, observation, and feedback to trainers. Monitor the LMS registration/attendance report to ensure trainer compliance with attendance tracking and managing data points for reporting training outcomes. Utilize university systems to monitor and approve trainer billing and manage staff time off hours as assigned.

Statewide travel is required

Bachelor’s degree. Three (3\) years in education, training and/or work experience in child welfare and/or foster care. Demonstrated supervisory or leadership experience. Project management experience. Training experience.


#### **Preferred Qualifications**


Master’s degree. Proficiency in technology, familiarity with Learning Management Systems, knowledge of Power BI, Excel, and other data management software, tracking, and reporting tools. #### **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**


* Knowledge of foster care practices in Illinois. Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills, with an ability to exercise independent judgment and make effective decisions. Excellent customer service interpersonal skills, effective communication, and the ability to follow instructions.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams) and Zoom, skilled in managing PDFs with Adobe Acrobat Reader. Skilled in data entry and managing workflows to meet deadlines efficiently.
* Leadership and team management skills with skills in strategic planning, generating analytical reports, and engaging stakeholders, and adaptable in high\-pressure environments with competing priorities.

#### **Appointment Information**


This is a 100% full\-time Civil Service 5002 \- Program Coordinator position, appointed on a 12\-month basis. The expected start date is as soon as possible after the search posting closes. **Department**


BSD IPP–NPH **About the Department**


The Institute for Population and Precision Health (IPPH), located in the Biological Sciences Division, integrates a wide spectrum of factors such as human health behaviors, environmental factors, social and economic factors, policies and genetic determinants of health, into studies focused on the treatment and prevention of disease, as well as the maintenance of wellness. Leveraging and integrating the University of Chicago’s considerable institutional strength in population science with research spanning diverse fields such as genetic medicine, cancer epidemiology, microbiome, and epigenomics, the Institute will have the common goal of improving human health outcomes. Another major goal of the Institute will be to develop a new multidisciplinary training program to equip researchers with emerging tools and methods to conduct precision health research within a population health framework. Our faculty lead research projects in biostatistics, epidemiology and health services research and participate in interdisciplinary teams with faculty in other departments to address complex problems in health and healthcare, in our communities and around the globe.  

  

**Job Summary**


UChicago is part of a mega\-National Institutes of Health (NIH) program that aims to be the first comprehensive study to investigate precision nutrition. The goal is to develop algorithms to predict individual responses to food and dietary routines. Close the loop with clean recaps (actuals vs. plan) and patterns that inform future planning.

* Strong written communication: clear enough to brief a vendor, direct enough to flag a risk to your manager
* Willingness and ability to travel multiple times per year

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Some of the most rewarding work you will ever do, solving real problems and helping people be the best versions of themselves
* Working alongside a team that is exceptionally smart and ambitious, but also humble and kind
* Generous retirement, equity, healthcare, and PTO policies

jobs.description:
**Community/Behavioral Health Outreach Coordinator**

**Organization Overview**

American Indian Health Service of Chicago, Inc. (AIHSC) is a federally qualified health center (FQHC) dedicated to providing comprehensive primary care, behavioral health services, case management, and community health education to the Native American community and other underserved populations of Chicago. Our mission is to improve the health and wellness of our community through accessible, high\-quality, and culturally appropriate health care services.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the communities we serve. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, particularly those with ties to Native American communities.

**Position Overview**

The Outreach Coordinator will support the Behavioral Health team by increasing awareness of available services; providing information and linkage to Behavioral Health services; developing educational and outreach materials; coordinating prevention activities; and strengthening relationships with community members. This role supports clinical staff by helping community members understand available services and connect to appropriate care, while allowing clinical staff to focus on direct patient care. The Outreach Coordinator does not schedule Behavioral Health appointments or make clinical referrals.

The Outreach Coordinator will also facilitate or co\-facilitate non\-clinical psycho\-educational, wellness, and culturally based support groups that promote prevention, resilience, healing, and community connection. AIHSC seeks a dependable, mission\-driven professional who is interested in a long\-term role and committed to building sustained, trusting relationships with community members, patients, partners, and colleagues.

**Scope of Services**

The Outreach Coordinator may provide non\-clinical psycho\-education, wellness support, culturally based support groups, community\-resource information, prevention education, and linkage to care. This position does not provide psychotherapy, clinical counseling, diagnosis, clinical assessment, or independent crisis intervention. When an individual has urgent behavioral health, safety, or crisis needs, the Outreach Coordinator will immediately notify and connect the individual with an appropriately qualified Behavioral Health clinician, supervisor, crisis service, emergency service, or other designated resource in accordance with AIHSC policy.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Community Outreach**

· Represent the Behavioral Health Department at community events, health fairs, powwows, schools, partner agencies, and outreach activities.

· Build trusting relationships with community members through consistent presence and engagement.

· Provide education regarding behavioral health, Substance Use Recovery Services (SURS), crisis resources, suicide prevention, and available community support.

· Conduct outreach activities designed to reduce stigma surrounding behavioral health services.

· Promote behavioral\-health groups, workshops, and community events.

· Conduct outreach to individuals who may benefit from behavioral\-health services and provide information and linkage to appropriate care.

**Groups, Prevention, and Community Programming**

· Facilitate or co\-facilitate non\-clinical psycho\-educational groups focused on wellness, stress management, coping skills, resiliency, healthy relationships, parenting, substance\-use prevention, and life skills.

· Coordinate with the Cultural Committee to support culturally responsive groups that promote healing, cultural identity, community connectedness, and traditional wellness practices.

· Assist Behavioral Health clinicians with community\-based workshops, educational presentations, and prevention programming.

· Monitor and document group attendance through sign\-in sheets, preregistration records, or other approved tracking methods.

**Educational Materials and Community Awareness**

· Assist with the development and distribution of culturally responsive flyers, brochures, and educational handouts.

· Coordinate dissemination of outreach and prevention materials throughout the community.

· Collaborate with the Behavioral Health team to identify educational topics based on emerging community needs and trends.

· Maintain outreach supplies, educational resources, and promotional materials.

**Collaboration, Documentation, and Quality Support**

· Attend Behavioral Health team meetings and assist with planning outreach, prevention, group, and community\-engagement activities.

· Collaborate with Behavioral Health clinicians, community partners, the Cultural Committee, and other AIHSC departments to support coordinated services.

· Document outreach contacts, group attendance, community events, educational materials distributed, linkage\-to\-care activities, and outcomes in approved tracking tools, databases, and/or the EHR, as applicable.

· Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential records in accordance with AIHSC policies, HIPAA requirements, and grant or program reporting requirements.

· Assist with data collection, program evaluation, and reporting activities related to outreach, prevention, and community engagement.

**Education and Experience**

· Associate degree required in human services, behavioral health, social services, public health, community health, education, or a related field.

· An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience in behavioral health, community outreach, peer support, social services, prevention, or community engagement may be considered.

· Experience providing community outreach, behavioral\-health support, social services, community education, peer support, or related services is preferred.

· Experience facilitating educational groups, support groups, or community workshops is preferred.

· Experience working with American Indian/Alaska Native communities, urb

The Center for the Economics of Human Development (CEHD) brings together top\-tier researchers to conduct and disseminate rigorous interdisciplinary research that identifies and explores the conditions under which people develop the skills necessary to thrive in society and achieve their fullest potential. At Yondr, we believe in the power of presence. Our mission is to create phone\-free spaces that deepen human connection and elevate shared experiences. We partner with artists, educators, and visionaries to design environments that put people, not devices, at the center.


Yondr’s business segments span numerous industries, primarily across education and live events. Yondr supports schools through cell phone\-free programs. Our education programs facilitate the successful implementation of phone\-free school environments by providing administrators and teachers with education, training, and development resources, along with all necessary equipment. In addition, Yondr supports top artists in music and comedy by creating phone\-free shows, allowing performers and audience members to enjoy live performances without the distraction of phones.

**SUMMARY**


Yondr is seeking an Account Manager / Sales Lead to drive new business and manage key client relationships across the Shows vertical. Reporting to the Director of Music \& Events, this role sits at the intersection of artist relations and commercial execution — owning outreach and deal development with artist teams, agents, and promoters while ensuring seamless account management for confirmed tours and engagements. The ideal candidate is relationship\-driven, commercially sharp, and deeply fluent in the live entertainment ecosystem.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Business Development \& Sales***

* Identify and pursue new business opportunities across music, comedy, and adjacent live entertainment verticals.
* Conduct proactive outreach to artist managers, booking agents, and promoters to develop and convert new Yondr shows.
* Own end\-to\-end deal management from initial pitch through contract execution, working closely with the Director on pricing, proposals, and negotiation.
* Maintain and grow a qualified pipeline of prospective artists and tours, with consistent forecasting and reporting to the Director.
* Support expansion into underdeveloped verticals including EDM, Country, sports, and emerging markets — with Theater and Broadway as active near\-term priorities.
* Collaborate with the Director on agency and promoter relationship strategy, including participation in key industry conferences and events.

***Account Management***

* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day point of contact for a portfolio of confirmed Shows clients.
* Manage client expectations, coordinate logistics, and ensure a high level of service from deal close through show execution.
* Collaborate closely with the Production team to ensure seamless handoff of confirmed engagements.
* Identify upsell and extension opportunities within existing accounts, including multi\-show and touring deals.
* Collect and track final ticket counts, billing documentation, and post\-show reporting.

***Relationship Development***

* Build and maintain strong, ongoing relationships with artist teams, agencies, promoters, and venues.
* Represent Yondr at industry events, showcases, and conferences in alignment with the department's visibility strategy.
* Contribute to the development of vertical sales materials, pitch decks, and artist testimonials in partnership with the Director and Marketing.

***Operations \& Reporting***

* Maintain accurate deal and client records in Airtable and internal systems.
* Support pipeline tracking, forecasting, and margin reporting in coordination with the Director and Finance.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

new_jobs.title: Client Success Representative
new_jobs.description:
**Client Success Representative**

**Location:** In\-Office/Remote: Candidates must reside in AZ, CA, IL, MT, NJ, NV, OR, TX, or WA

**Reports To:** VP of Growth

**Role Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site in El Segundo or Remote

**Compensation:** $60,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00

*(Compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, location, and the Company’s approved budget for the position.)*

**About QuikStor**


QuikStor is the leading SaaS facility management platform for the self\-storage industry, delivering a purpose\-built, scalable system that serves as the foundation for intelligent automation and modern facility operations. We are in rapid growth mode, backed by significant capital from self\-storage industry veterans who share our vision to build the most advanced and scalable operating system for storage operators worldwide.

**Role Overview**


The Client Success Representative is an account management role that owns the relationship with a portfolio of QuikStor clients from the completion of initial implementation through the life of the account. The Representative is introduced at the start of implementation and becomes the primary relationship owner after go\-live.


The role has two priorities: retention and growth. The Representative drives feature adoption, serves as the client’s main point of contact, and coordinates with Support to ensure issues are resolved. They also identify opportunities to upsell modules and features and expand accounts through additional facilities and services.


This is a post\-sale account management role, not a new business/hunter role. The Representative earns a commission on the collected recurring revenue of every assigned account, phased in over the first year of each assignment, and a commission on all new business added to those accounts. The plan resets every January. Success is measured by gross and net revenue retention, new business added, collections, feature adoption, and client satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Relationship Ownership**

* Own the relationship for an assigned portfolio of clients and all their facilities after implementation.
* Be introduced during implementation, participate in key touchpoints, and assume ownership at go\-live.
* Serve as the primary client contact for any issue, and route day\-to\-day technical issues to Support, which remains the first line of support.
* Build trusted relationships with owners, operators, regional managers, and facility staff.
* Keep HubSpot records accurate and current, including contacts, facilities, products, contract terms, and account health.
* Maintain an account plan for each client covering renewals, growth opportunities, and risks.
**Client Engagement and Feature Adoption**

* Confirm at handoff that each facility is operating on the platform as designed and that the client knows how to get help.
* Drive adoption of key QuikStor features, including automated rent increases, delinquency and auction workflows, online payments and autopay, websites and web components, payment processing, insurance, and access control integrations.
* Conduct training and scheduled check\-ins to reinforce best practices and increase adoption across facility teams.
* Introduce clients to new releases and capabilities and help them implement and maximize their value.
* Coordinate with the Training team to develop client curriculum and onboard new client staff.
**Retention and Account Health**

* Monitor usage, support activity, billing status, and satisfaction to identify at\-risk accounts early and act on them
* Run a regular review cadence with every account, including quarterly business reviews for larger operators
* Own renewals end to end and resolve commercial issues before they become cancellation risks
* Partner with Finance on past\-due balances and billing questions so that collected revenue stays current
**Upsell and Account Expansion**

* Identify and close expansion within assigned accounts, including additional facilities, add\-on modules, website and web component subscriptions, insurance programs, and other recurring services
* Prepare quotes and order forms within approved pricing and partner with Sales leadership on anything outside standard terms
* Refer hardware, professional services, and net\-new operator opportunities to Sales
* Track every expansion from signed order through go\-live and first payment
**Client Advocacy \& Feedback Sales:**

* Capture client feedback and feature requests in Intercom for Product review
* Follow open support issues for assigned accounts through the Support team's tracker process, push for resolution, and keep the client informed
* Share client insights with Product, Marketing, Implementation, and Support
**Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Support to drive timely client issue resolution without owning the support queue
* Collaborate with Product and Marketing on client communication and enablement
* Coordinate with Finance and Operations to maintain accurate billing, contracts, and account records
**How Success Is Measured**

* Gross and net revenue retention of the assigned portfolio.

**Program Coordinator, San Francisco** 

**Organization:** The Thriving Initiative **Location:** Hybrid (Approximately 75% remote, 25% in\-person)\| San Francisco, CA

**Employment Type:** Part\-Time **Hours:** 10\-15 hours per week **Compensation:** $20–$22 per hour

**Who We Are**

The Thriving Initiative is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit serving survivors on college campuses including San Francisco State University, San Diego State University, and UC Santa Barbara. Our programs are survivor\-centered, trauma\-informed, and grounded in deep respect for community healing.

We are a small but highly committed team. Every staff member is here because they believe in this work. We value innovation, empathy, community, and respect.

**Position Overview**

The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in the day\-to\-day program operations and community\-facing presence of The Thriving Initiative at San Francisco State University (SFSU) and in the broader San Francisco community. This role will support the planning and execution of events and workshops, build and nurture campus and community partnerships, and serve as an accessible point of contact for students seeking resources and connection. The ideal candidate is organized, empathetic, and passionate about improving the lives of survivors. This role reports to the Program Operations Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program \& Event Support**

* Oversee and implement weekly in\-person healing and recovery workshops utilizing diverse alternative forms of healing
* Oversee logistics for events and workshops, including ordering and bringing physical workshop materials, setting up venues, and coordinating with service providers before, during, and after each event.
* Attend weekly staff meetings and a weekly one\-on\-one meeting with the Program Manager
* Works collaboratively with program team to ensure smooth program operations
* Attend and support both on\-campus and off\-campus planned events
* Assist with financial management related to events and workshops, including tracking expenditures and processing orders
* Oversee participant intake and attendance rosters for all sessions
* Assist with additional projects that are assigned

**Student Engagement**

* Directly coordinate all SFSU volunteer engagement activities and oversight.
* Hold regular weekly office hours to provide student volunteers with an accessible, welcoming space to connect, ask questions, and plan activities
* Plan and coordinate bonding activities for student officers to build community and team cohesion
* Draft communication and outreach templates to streamline student officer tasks and outreach efforts
* Empower the volunteer team to create safe, welcoming spaces where survivors feel seen and supported

**Program Outreach** 

* Collaborate with on\-campus partners in planning and delivering programming and events
* Support coordination of tabling events, campus involvement fairs, and promotional flyering across SFSU to drive event attendance
* Closely collaborate with Communications and Outreach coordinator to co\-lead weekly marketing meetings, ensure proper volunteer engagement, and appropriate content creation

**Partnership Development**

* Cultivate and maintain on\-campus partnerships with relevant university departments, student organizations, and offices
* Lead occasional local funding request opportunities
* Foster and strengthen relationships with community partners to expand The Thriving Initiative’s network of support and resources

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Commitment to supporting survivors of interpersonal violence and sexual assault
* Prior involvement in advocacy, social justice, mental health, or survivor support work
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with volunteers, staff, workshop participants, and community partners
* Comfort with basic financial tracking and administrative tasks
* Knowledge of San Francisco State University clubs, organizations, administration, etc.
* Reliable transportation to and from events
* Must be able to transport workshop materials to and from program sites in a timely manner, including loading and unloading supplies up to 25 pounds, reasonable accommodations can be made.

**Preferred**

* Experience in event planning, program coordination, or nonprofit work
* Experience working with or within campus communities
* Bachelors degree or equivalent work experience
* Trauma\-informed training will be provided, but previous mental health experience is a major plus

**Working Conditions**

This is a part\-time, hybrid position with in\-person requirements near San Francisco State University campus. Some off\-campus travel for events and community partnerships may be required. Hours may occasionally vary around events and workshops.

**Compensation \& Work Structure**

* **Pay rate:** $20–$22 per hour
* **Hours:** Approximately 15 hours per week

**Benefits**

* Flexible scheduling
* A highly collaborative, mission\-aligned team environment

* The opportunity to contribute directly to survivor\-centered work that creates real change

**Program** **Coordinator**


**Location:** Hybrid; California\-based, with a strong preference for the San Francisco Bay Area  

**Status:** Full\-time, Exempt  

**Reports to:** Senior Program Manager


**Salary** Range: $58,839\-$88,259


**About the Center for Care Innovations**  

The Center for Care Innovations (CCI) is a nonprofit organization working to transform the health care safety net. Our mission is to spark, seed, and spread innovations that strengthen the health and wellbeing of historically underinvested communities.  

  

For more than 25 years, CCI has worked alongside safety net organizations to navigate a changing health care landscape, test new approaches, strengthen organizations and leaders, and help promising ideas spread across the field. Rooted in California, we partner with community health centers, public hospitals, community\-based organizations, managed care plans, public agencies, and philanthropy.  

  

Our work spans capacity\-building initiatives, advising and consulting, and ecosystem development: running intensive learning collaboratives and accelerators, providing tailored advising and research, and hosting cross\-sector gatherings. These bring people together to tackle some of the health care safety net's most pressing challenges.  

  

For more information, please see the www.careinnovations.org (http://www.careinnovations.org/).
  

  

**About the Program Coordinator Role**


CCI is looking for a collaborative, proactive, and organized Program Coordinator to support initiatives that help health care safety net organizations improve care and advance health equity. This is a great role for someone who has experience supporting complex initiatives and enjoys keeping many moving pieces organized, anticipating what different stakeholders need, and creating a thoughtful experience for participants and partners.  

  

You'll work across multiple CCI initiatives and team configurations, building your experience in project management, health systems improvement, events and learning experiences, and partner engagement. new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator 2
new_jobs.description:
Stanford University's Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Spine Division is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Clinical Research Coordinator 2 (CRC2\) to support the research program. This position plays a central and independent role in managing all aspects of PI’s research portfolio, including industry\-funded clinical trials, multi\-site collaborations, registry studies, and grant\-funded projects including PI\-Initiated projects. The CRC2 serves as the primary research contact for sponsors, collaborators, IRBs, and internal stakeholders, and will work closely with surgical faculty, residents, fellows, and students.


This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced research professional seeking meaningful responsibility in a dynamic academic medical center environment.


Must possess and maintain a valid California non\-commercial Class C Driver’s License.


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS\*:**

* Ability to drive day or night.
* Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping.
* Occasionally sit, reach above shoulders, perform desk based computer tasks, use a telephone and write by hand, lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh up to 40 pounds.
* Rarely kneel, crawl, climb ladders, grasp forcefully, sort and file paperwork or parts, rarely lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh 40 pounds or more.

*\* \- Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.*

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* Position may at times require the employee to work with or be in areas where hazardous materials and/or exposure to chemicals, blood, body fluid or tissues and risk of exposure to contagious diseases and infections.
May require extended or unusual work hours based on research requirements and business needs  
* 

**WORK STANDARDS:**

* When conducting university business, must comply with California Vehicle Code and Stanford University driving requirements.
* Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates the ability to work well with Stanford colleagues and clients and with external organizations.
* Promote Culture of Safety: Demonstrates commitment to personal responsibility and value for safety; communicates safety concerns; uses and promotes safe behaviors based on training and lessons learned.
* Subject to and expected to comply with all applicable University policies and procedures, including but not limited to the personnel policies and other policies found in the University's Administrative Guide, http://adminguide.stanford.edu .

  
**Core Duties** :


* Oversee subject recruitment and study enrollment goals. Determine effective strategies for promoting/recruiting research participants and retaining participants in long\-term clinical trials.
* Oversee data management for research projects. Develop and manage systems to organize, collect, report, and monitor data collection. Extract, analyze, and interpret data.
* Develop project schedules, targets, measurements, and accountabilities, as assigned. Lead team meetings and prepare/approve minutes.
* Formally supervise, train, and/or mentor new staff or students, as assigned, potentially including hiring, preparing or assisting with the preparation of performance evaluations, and performing related duties, in addition to instruction on project work.
* Audit operations, including laboratory procedures, to ensure compliance with applicable regulations; provide leadership in identifying and implementing corrective actions/processes. Monitor Institutional Review Board submissions and respond to requests and questions.
* Collaborate with principal investigators and study sponsors, monitor and report serious adverse events, and resolve study queries.
* Provide leadership in determining, recommending, and implementing improvements to policies/processes; define best practices.
* Develop study budget with staff and principal investigator, identifying standard of care versus study procedures. Track patient and study specific milestones, and invoice sponsors according to study contract.
* Ensure regulatory compliance. Regularly inspect study documents to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
Work with principal investigator to ensure Investigational New Drug applications are submitted to the FDA when applicable. Ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed.  
* 

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in a related field and two years of experience in clinical research, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and database applications.
* Experience with research protocols and regulatory or governing bodies, which include HIPAA and FDA regulations, Institutional Review Board requirements, and Good Clinical Practices.
Knowledge of medical terminology.  
* 

**Certificates and Licenses Required**

Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification is preferred.

The ideal candidate will have existing industry ties in AI infrastructure, data centers, enterprise IT, colocation, or critical facilities, along with a history of sourcing and securing new ventures independently. This is a field\-based remote role. **Work Arrangement**: On\-site, Hybrid \& Remote

 **Position Requirements*** BA/BS in a business or technical related field or equivalent combination of education and experience required. MBA a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience selling relevant and related products; experience with data center/IT infrastructure products a plus.
* Proficient computer, software, and data analysis skills (Salesforce.com/CRM, Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
* Demonstrate strong initiative, resiliency, organizational and time management skills
* Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Excellent problem solver with strong negotiation and presentation skills
* Proven record in business development and account planning/management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Resourceful and ability to adapt quickly to changing environment
* Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage time within a fast\-paced environment
* Travel up to 25% of the time

At the heart of our work is **Flatbush Veterinary Clinic**, a high\-volume nonprofit clinic serving low\-income pet owners, rescue organizations, and Trap\-Neuter\-Return (TNR) volunteers throughout Brooklyn. Each year, the clinic performs more than 7,500 spay/neuter surgeries—a number that continues to grow—while providing affordable wellness and dental care to thousands of pets.

**People Operations**

We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives.

  



### **Why Work Here?**

  

  

We’re looking for people who can change the world.

  

Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.
